Lapsevanemate kohaselt toimus see juhtum reede, kui õpetaja jagas ilmselt õpilasi rahvuse järgi, kutsus klassi 'tühjaks' ja ütles mustadele õpilastele: 'Ma tean, kust te kõik olete' ja 'Ma näen, et teie mõlemad ei saa kodu pealt karistust.' Ühe õpilase ema Sandra Lee ütles, et tema tütar rääkis sellest kohe pärast kooli. Lee külastas kooli esmaspäeval, et esitada ametlikku kaebust, ja ütles: 'Kõik, mis toimus, oli rasistlik.' Fort Worthi Iseseisev Koolide Ringkond kinnitas, et ta sai teada sellest kaebusest reede päeval ja kogub õpilaste seest lausumisi. Vastutav õpetaja pole ametlikult nimetatud, kuigi Edgar Cajas on kooli veebilehel loetletud ainus muusikaõpetaja — tema seos juhtumiga pole kindlaks tehtud. Mõned lapsevanemad mainisid ka eelmise aasta alguses tehtud kaebusi muusikatunnis, sealhulgas filmitööd, mis sisaldasid kurjakeelseid sõnu ja vägivalda. Ringkonna pressiesindaja Clint Bond ütles: 'Kooli ja ringkonna juhtimine teadis kaebustest juba eelmise reede päeval. Kui faktid on teada, võetakse sobivad meetmed.'

article_content: Cesar Laurean, a 22-year-old U.S. Marine corporal, has been returned to North Carolina after being extradited from Mexico to face charges in the 2007 killing of 20-year-old pregnant Marine Lance Cpl. Maria Lauterbach. He was arrested in April 2008 in San Juan Vina, Mexico, and held pending extradition due to his dual U.S.-Mexican citizenship. Laurean is now incarcerated at the Onslow County Detention Center, awaiting trial for first-degree murder, fraud, and deception related to Lauterbach’s death. Lauterbach vanished in December 2007 and was later found dead alongside her unborn child beneath a fire pit in Laurean’s backyard near Camp Lejeune. Authorities say Laurean used her ATM card ten days after her disappearance before fleeing. The autopsy determined she died from severe blunt-force trauma to the head — not the non-fatal neck injury noted at the scene. A note written by Laurean and given to his wife claimed Lauterbach had slit her own throat, but investigators found no evidence supporting that story. Lauterbach had reported being raped by Laurean, and her family believes he was the father of her child. Laurean denied any sexual contact with her. His wife, Christina, was not implicated in the crime and was unaware of the murder before turning over the note. The Marine Corps had dismissed Lauterbach’s prior complaints of harassment, including threats and vandalism to her vehicle, prompting criticism from her mother and relatives. Because Mexico does not allow extradition for cases where the death penalty is sought, Laurean can only face life imprisonment without parole if convicted. He remains on active duty status as a deserter, though he is being processed through the civilian justice system. The FBI and local authorities collaborated to track him down after he went missing in January 2008. During his arrest, Laurean told reporters, 'I loved her.'

Laurean on praegu Onslow County vanglates, ootamas kohtuprotsessi esimest järku tapmuse, pettuse ja valeid esitlusi seoses Lauterbachi surmaga. Lauterbach kadus detsembris 2007 ja leiti hiljem surnuna koos oma lootega Laureani tagatagusele tulekütuse alla lähedal Camp Lejeunes. Autorite sõnul kasutas Laurean tema ATM-kaarti 10 päeva pärast tema kadumist enne põgenemist. Autopsia näitas, et ta suri raskest tõmbetõrjel pähe — mitte mitte surmavast kaelahaavast, mis oli leitud kohal. Laureani poolt kirjutatud märkus, mis anti tema naisele, väitis, et Lauterbach oli ise enda kaela lõiknud, kuid uurijad ei leidnud tõendeid, mis seda lugu tõendaks. Lauterbach oli rapistamise süüdistust esitanud Laureani vastu, ja tema perekond usub, et ta oli tema loote isa. Laurean keeldus suhtlemast Lauterbachiga. Tema naine Christina ei olnud kuriteo osaline ja ei teadnud tapmusest enne märkuse esitamist. Merevägi oli eelmised hukkamõistetud kuritegude ja kahju teenimise ja autoga ründamise süüdistused ignoreerinud, mis põhjustas kriitikat tema ema ja sugulaste seas. Kuna Meksiko ei luba ekstraditsiooni juhtudel, kus soovitakse surmanuhtlust, võib Laurean saada ainult eluajalise vanglakaristuse ilma vabastuseta, kui ta on süüdi tõestatud. Ta jääb aktiivses teenistuses deserteerijana, kuid ta töödeldakse tsiviiljustiisikohus. FBI ja kohalikud ametnikud olid koostöös tema tagasitöötlemisel pärast tema kadumist jaanuaris 2008. Arreteerimise ajal ütles Laurean ajakirjanikele: 'Ma armastasin teda.'

article_content: Sgt. Andrew Tahmooressi, a U.S. Marine Corps reservist, is still behind bars in Mexico after mistakenly driving across the border with three firearms in his truck — a situation he says began with a simple navigation error. Detained since March 31 near Tijuana, Tahmooressi maintains he never intended to enter Mexico illegally and was unaware he was carrying weapons across the border. The firearms — a .45-caliber pistol, a 12-gauge shotgun, and an AR-15 rifle — triggered a legal cascade that has yet to resolve. His attorney, Fernando Benitez, revealed serious flaws in the case against him, including a search warrant dated three days before the incident and more than ten pages missing from official court records. Tahmooressi also claims he was denied proper translation support, making communication nearly impossible. Contrary to reports from Mexican border officials suggesting he was offered a chance to turn back without consequence, Tahmooressi told CNN he was never given such an option. In fact, he recalls pleading with officers: 'Take my guns, my truck, everything — just let me go home.' They shook their heads. Now, with his next court date set for August 4, Tahmooressi’s family and legal team believe justice is being delayed by systemic missteps. His mother, Jill, described him as resilient and grateful for his lawyer’s dedication. 'He’s not a criminal,' she said. 'He’s a soldier who got lost — and now he’s paying the price for a system that didn’t listen.'

Ta on vangistatud alates 31. märtsist lähedal Tijuanas. Tahmooressi väidab, et ta ei kavandanud Meksikasse illegaalselt siseneda ja ei olnud teadlik, et ta kandsid relvi piiri üle. article_content: An outbreak of bubonic plague in Madagascar has claimed nearly 50 lives and is spreading to the capital, Antananarivo, officials warned. Since the start of the year, there have been 138 suspected cases and 47 confirmed deaths — numbers expected to rise in the coming months. Two cases have been detected in Antananarivo, including one fatality. Health workers have launched a pest control campaign in slum areas surrounding the city. The health ministry reported that 200 households have been disinfected this month, and close contacts of infected individuals have received antibiotics to curb transmission. The World Health Organization stated last week that 40 deaths had been attributed to the outbreak, which was first identified in August. Bubonic plague is transmitted by fleas that typically infest rats; humans become infected through bites. The bubonic form causes swollen lymph nodes but is treatable with antibiotics. The pneumonic form, which affects the lungs, can spread person-to-person via respiratory droplets and may be fatal within 24 hours if untreated. According to the United Nations health agency, a high level of insecticide resistance in fleas is complicating containment efforts. In Ankasina, a slum near Antananarivo, the family of a young woman who died from the disease says they have faced community stigma. Her mother, Bernadette Rasoarimanana, said neighbors have given them 'dirty looks' since her daughter’s death. Residents describe overcrowded, unsanitary conditions teeming with rats — increasing infection risks. 'Our neighborhood is filthy and has been neglected by the state for years,' she said. Plague outbreaks are seasonal in Madagascar, peaking between October and March. The last case in Antananarivo occurred a decade ago, according to Christophe Rogier of the Institut Pasteur. He suggested the bacterium may have persisted silently in rat populations during that time. 'Rats are a natural reservoir of plague and can survive the disease,' he noted. Since 2009, Madagascar has averaged about 500 plague cases per year, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross. The bacterium responsible, Yersinia pestis, caused the 14th-century Black Death, which killed an estimated 25–50 million people in Europe. While bubonic plague has largely disappeared from developed nations, 90% of global cases today occur in Africa.

Tervishoiutöötajad on alustanud linnapiirkondade põhjalikku putukate kontrolli. Tervishoiuministeerium teatas, et selle kuu jooksul on desinfitseeritud 200 kodu ja nende lähedased kontaktisikud on saanud antibioote, et peatada haiguse levikut. Maailma Terviseorganisatsioon teatas viimase nädala jooksul, et 40 inimest on surnud plagi tõttu, mida tuvastati augustis. Bubooniline plagg levib loomulikult hiirte külge kleepuvate mardikate kaudu; inimesed nakatuvad nendega haavamisel. Bubooniline vorm põhjustab lümfisõlmede turse, kuid seda saab ravida antibiootikumidega. Pneumoniline vorm, mis mõjutab kopsusid, võib levida inimeselt inimesele kõhkluste kaudu ja võib olla surmav 24 tunni jooksul, kui seda ei ravi. Ühinenud Rahvaste Organisatsiooni tervishoiuasutus ütles, et mardikate kõrge resistentsus insektitsiidide vastu raskendab kontrolli. Antananarivust lähedal asuvas rikkalises asulas Ankasinas ütles noore naise perekond, kes suri plagi tõttu, et nad on kohtunud ühiskonna eirusega. Tema ema Bernadette Rasoarimanana ütles, et naabrid on annetanud talle 'väljendavaid silmepeegleid' tema tütre surma pärast. Asulakogukonnad kirjeldavad ülekaasatud ja ebakorrapäraseid tingimusi, mis on täis hiiri — see suurendab nakatumise ohtu. 'Meie linnaosa on väga must ja on riigi poolt aastaid hoolimata jätetud,' ütles ta. Madagaskaril on plagi väljendid sezonalsed ja neil on kõrgeim tase oktoobrist kuni märtsini. Viimane juhtum pealinnas oli kümmekond aastat tagasi, ütles Institut Pasteuri Kristof Rogier. Ta soovitas, et bakter võis olla viimase kümne aasta jooksul vaikses seisundis hiirte populatsioonis. 'Hiired on plagi loomulik reservuaar ja nad suudavad haigust ellu jätta,' lisas ta. Alates 2009. aastast on Madagaskaril keskmiselt registreeritud umbes 500 plagi juhtu aastas, ütles Rahvusvaheline Punane Rist. Vastutav bakter, Yersinia pestis, põhjustas 14. sajandi Musta Surma, mis sai suretud umbes 25–50 miljonit inimest Euroopas. Kuna bubooniline plagg on peaaegu kadunud arenenud maailmast, toimub 90% kõigist juhtudest täna Aafrikas.

article_content: London photographer Joel Devlin, 34, turned a simple idea into stunning art: capturing the invisible dance of airplanes over the city. Using long 45-minute exposures at dusk, he recorded the glowing trails left by aircraft taking off and landing at Heathrow and London City Airports. The results? A mesmerizing tapestry of red, white, and blue-green light streaks crisscrossing the night sky — like celestial graffiti painted by machines. Heathrow, one of the busiest airports globally, handles roughly 1,288 flights per day and connects London to 80 countries. With only two runways, its skies are packed — perfect raw material for Devlin’s 'Aviation Vectors' project. His photos also reveal how light pollution paints parts of the sky orange, while others glow softly under twilight hues above London City Airport, a quieter but still vital hub. Among the most frequent destinations are New York, Dubai, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, and Dublin. Each streak in his images tells a story — of travelers, cargo, and connections spanning continents. What began as a technical experiment became a poetic glimpse into the rhythm of modern air travel.
translated_content: Londrina fotograaf Joel Devlin, 34, teisendas lihtsa idee imetlusväärseks kunstiks: ta pildistas linnas lendavate lennukite nähtamatut tantsu. Ta kasutas 45-minutilisi pikki eksponeerimisi õhtusoojuses, salvestades lennukite jäljed, mis jätavad Heathrowi ja London City lennujaama lähedal valgusjälgide. Tulemuseks on hirmutav punaste, valgete ja sinise-roheliste valgusjoonte tapeet, mis ristuvad öötaeva peal — nagu kosmilised grafitid, mida maalivad masinad. Heathrow, üks maailma tähtsamaid lennujaamu, korraldab umbes 1288 lendu päevas ja ühendab Lontoost 80 riigiga. Vaid kahe start- ja landimisradaga on tema taevas täis — täpne materjal Devlini projekti 'Aviation Vectors' jaoks. Tema pildid näitavad ka, kuidas valguspollutsioon värvib osa taevast oranžiks, samas kui teised pildid heidavad pehmeid õhtusoojuste hue’de London City Airporti üle, vaiksemat kuid veelgi olulist lennujaama. Kõige sagedasemad sihtkohad on New York, Dubai, Frankfurt, Amsterdam ja Dublin. Iga joon tema piltidel räägib lugu — rändajatest, kaubast ja kontinentide vahelistest ühendustest. Mis algas tehnilise eksperimentina, sai poeetiliseks pilguks modernse lennuliikluse ritmi suhtes.

article_content: Since publicly disclosing his undocumented status last November, Pedro Ramirez — the student body president at Fresno State — has endured a wave of threats, including menacing voicemails with gunshots and laughter in the background. His personal phone number, made public due to his position, was leaked, leading to harassing calls from across the country — even from someone in Utah who claimed they were coming to make a 'citizen’s arrest.' Ramirez came to the U.S. with his parents when he was just three years old and has spent nearly his entire life in Tulare, California. He once believed his family had corrected their immigration status — until he tried to join the military and discovered he wasn’t a citizen. For four years, he kept his status private, sharing it only with close friends. But when an anonymous source revealed it to the campus paper, The Collegian, everything changed. Reactions were polarized. While a small but loud minority condemned him, Fresno State President John D. Welty stood firmly behind him, praising Ramirez and other AB 540 students for pursuing higher education despite immense obstacles. AB 540 lets eligible undocumented students pay in-state tuition rates in California’s public colleges. Welty connected Ramirez’s story to the broader push for the Dream Act — legislation that would offer a pathway to citizenship for undocumented youth brought to the U.S. as children. Though the bill passed the House, it was blocked in the Senate by a Republican filibuster. One of Ramirez’s most outspoken critics is fellow student Neil O’Brien, whose parents immigrated legally from Argentina. O’Brien runs a website called 'TheRealPedro.com,' arguing that everyone must follow the legal system — and that Ramirez shouldn’t be treated differently. 'We’re a nation of laws,' O’Brien insists, distancing his stance from racism or opposition to diversity. Ramirez isn’t alone. Other students like Jessica Colotl in Georgia and Mariano Cardoso in Connecticut have recently won temporary reprieves from deportation, sparking hope among undocumented youth. Ramirez welcomed these outcomes, saying they reflect a growing public desire to give young people a chance — not to deport them. Now preparing to graduate in May, Ramirez hopes to pursue a master’s in public administration. 'Until Congress acts,' he says, 'there’s no legal path for me.' He acknowledges his role as a lightning rod — but insists the overwhelming response has been support, not hate.
translated_content: Pärast oma dokumendita staatusi avalikustamist novembris on Fresno Statei õppetööde presidendi Pedro Ramirezi vastu tõstatatud mitmeid uhiendusi, sealhulgas ohustavad heliteated, kus oli laskmise ja naeru hääl. Tema isiklik telefoninumber, mis oli avalik tema ametikoha tõttu, lekkis ja viis hirmutavatele kõnedele kogu riigist — isegi Utahist, kus keegi väitis, et tuleb Kaliforniasse, et teha 'kodanikupidurdamist'. Ramirez tuli Ameerika Ühendriikidesse koos vanematega kolmeaastasena ja on veetnud peaaegu kogu elu Tulare’is, Californias. Ta uskus varem, et tema perekond on oma migratsiooniseisundi parandanud — kuni ta proovis sõjaväkke astuda ja sai teada, et ta ei ole kodanik. Nelja aasta jooksul hoidis ta oma staatusi salajaseks, jagades seda ainult lähedaste sõpradega. Kuid kui anonüümne allikas avastas selle Fresno State'i kampuslehele The Collegianile, muutus kõik. Reaktsioonid olid eraldatud. Kuigi väike, kuid häälekas väikegrupp tõrjus teda, toetas Fresno Statei rektor John D. Welty teda kindlalt, kiides hinnaks Ramirezi ja teisi AB 540 õpilasi nende suurete takistuste hoolimata kõrgema hariduse otsimise eest. AB 540 lubab sobivatel dokumenditeta õpilastel maksta kalifornialaste tasusid kõrgemas hariduses. Welty seostas Ramirezi lugu laiemaga Dream Acti — seadusega, mis pakub dokumenditeta noorukitele, kes tulid Ameerikasse lapsepõlves, teekonda kodakondsuse poole. Kuigi seadus läbis esindajate koja, blokeeris senat seda republiklase füliibusteriga. Üks Ramirezi kõige aktiivsematest kriitikutest on õpilane Neil O’Brien, kelle vanemad olid õiguslikult immigratsiooni teel Ameerikasse tulnud Argentina päritolu. O’Brien hooldab veebilehte 'TheRealPedro.com', argumenteerides, et kõik peavad järgima õiguslikku protsessi — ja et Ramirezi ei tohiks erandina kohtleda. 'Me oleme seaduste riik,' ütles O’Brien, eemaldades oma seisukoha rasismist või mitte-vaimsest mitmekesisusest. Ramirez pole üksi. article_content: An archer has achieved an impressive feat of marksmanship by splitting one arrow with another. South Korean archer Joo Hyun-jung performed the shot — known among archers as a 'Robin Hood' — during a practice session for the Archery World Cup in Medellín, Colombia. A 'Robin Hood' shot occurs when one arrow strikes and splits another already embedded in the target. The feat is akin to a golfer scoring two holes-in-one in the same round. The iconic maneuver has appeared in several Robin Hood films: in the 1938 classic The Adventures of Robin Hood, stunt archer Howard Hill reportedly split a target-embedded arrow. However, in the 1991 film Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves, starring Kevin Costner, the effect was achieved using special effects, with the camera following the arrow’s flight path. In 2008, British blind archer Tilly Trotter, then 74, pulled off the same shot during a practice session with the Wellington Bowmen in Somerset. She told The Daily Telegraph: 'The second arrow made such a loud noise hitting the back of the first arrow that I thought I’d hit the ceiling or caused some expensive damage. Then I heard people jumping up and down shouting that I’d done a Robin Hood. It was a one-in-a-million shot — and a bit of a fluke, really.' Peter Jones, a spokesperson for the Grand National Archery Society, noted: 'It’s an extremely rare feat — like getting two holes-in-one on the same round of golf.'

article_content: For years, the U.S. Navy has been developing a practical directed-energy weapon to enhance ship self-defense capabilities. Now, with a series of successful tests of the Laser Weapon System (LaWS), it may be one step closer to achieving that goal. The Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), the Navy’s technology development arm, announced today that LaWS successfully tracked, engaged, and destroyed a drone in flight during an over-the-water test off San Nicolas Island, California. While not the first instance of lasers disabling unmanned aerial vehicles — the U.S. Air Force conducted similar tests at China Lake, California, last year — this test introduces greater operational realism and a significant technical hurdle: laser beams weaken when traveling through the moist, salty air above the ocean. LaWS is essentially a laser upgrade to the MK 15 Close-In Weapon System (CIWS), commonly known as the Phalanx gun — a radar-guided 20mm autocannon already deployed on U.S. Navy surface ships. According to NAVSEA, the tested system fired a laser through a beam director mounted on the same tracking platform used by the Phalanx, meaning it leverages the existing CIWS control system. This integration represents a potential evolution for the Phalanx, which is currently limited by the range of its 20mm cannon. Raytheon, the manufacturer of the Phalanx, is also promoting a missile-based replacement, but LaWS offers a complementary option: extended engagement range without exhausting ammunition. The Phalanx serves as a last-line defense against sea-skimming anti-ship missiles and hostile aircraft. While LaWS could extend that range, the gun will remain as a reliable backup if the laser fails under adverse conditions. LaWS may also have land-based applications. Phalanx systems have previously been used in Iraq and Afghanistan to intercept incoming rockets and mortars. article_content: The U.S. Department of Justice is preparing to file a civil lawsuit against Arizona Sheriff Joe Arpaio, following the collapse of settlement negotiations. Arpaio, widely known as 'America’s toughest sheriff,' has been under federal scrutiny for years over allegations of systemic discrimination against Latinos in his Maricopa County Sheriff’s Office (MCSO). The DOJ had proposed a settlement requiring the appointment of an independent federal monitor to oversee reforms — a condition it called 'key and non-negotiable.' However, Arpaio canceled the final meeting scheduled to discuss the proposal, prompting the DOJ to conclude he was not negotiating in good faith. In a letter to Arpaio’s legal team, Deputy Assistant Attorney General Roy Austin Jr. stated: 'MCSO’s refusal to engage in good faith negotiations requires us to prepare for civil action.' Arpaio responded defiantly, accusing the Obama administration of attempting to strip him of his elected authority by imposing an outside monitor. A 22-page DOJ report released in December detailed a pervasive culture of racial bias within MCSO. Investigators found detention officers routinely used racist slurs against Hispanic detainees — including 'wetbacks' and 'Mexican bitches' — and that Arpaio himself had endorsed calls for mass 'round-ups' of dark-skinned individuals. The investigation also revealed that 432 cases of sexual assault and child molestation went uninvestigated between 2004 and 2007, many involving Latino victims. Additionally, MCSO officers engaged in unlawful stops, detentions, and arrests of Latinos at rates four to nine times higher than those of non-Latinos. The DOJ further found that Latino inmates with limited English were punished and denied essential services. Assistant Attorney General Thomas Perez described the racial profiling uncovered as 'the most egregious' he had ever seen. The investigation, launched in 2008 and expanded after Arpaio’s initial lack of cooperation, led to a landmark 2010 lawsuit — one of the few times the federal government sued a local law enforcement agency for civil rights violations. Arpaio, a Republican, dismissed the findings as a politically driven 'witch hunt,' pointing to President Obama’s opposition to Arizona’s immigration law and suggesting Democratic officials targeted him to score political points. He insisted, 'Don’t come to use me as a whipping boy for a national, international problem.'

article_content: For aspiring athletes, relentless practice alone won’t turn you into a world-class sprinter—if you weren’t naturally fast to begin with. New research from Grand Valley State University challenges the widely accepted '10,000-hour rule' popularized by Malcolm Gladwell, which claims that deliberate practice is all it takes to achieve mastery in any field—including sports. The study, published in PeerJ, analyzed the developmental histories of 26 elite sprinters, including 15 Olympic gold medalists and the eight fastest men in U.S. history. Every single one was identified as exceptionally fast long before receiving formal coaching. Contrary to the 10-year timeline suggested by Gladwell’s model, most of these athletes reached world-class levels in fewer than five years—and more than half achieved it in three years or less. Researchers Michael Lombardo and Robert Deaner also surveyed 64 NCAA track and field athletes competing in 2012. Sprinters remembered being the fastest kids in their neighborhoods as children, while throwers recalled superior strength and throwing ability early on. Even in their first high school season—when formal training typically begins—these sprinters performed faster than 95–99% of their peers. 'There were no exceptions,' said Lombardo. 'From Helen Stephens in 1936 to Usain Bolt, every elite sprinter showed signs of extraordinary speed before training ever started.' Deaner added: 'This isn’t surprising to biologists or coaches—but it’s a crucial correction for social scientists still clinging to the idea that talent doesn’t matter in sports.' The findings suggest that innate physical ability plays a decisive role in sprinting success—and that the 'practice-only' model fails to explain elite athletic achievement.

Igaüks neist oli tuvastatud erandlikult kiireks enne kui ta sai formaalset treeningut. article_content: Two years after the devastating 2010 earthquake near Port-au-Prince, Haiti’s humanitarian crisis drew an unprecedented wave of support — much of it coming through simple text messages. Donors across the U.S. sent $10 at a time by texting 'HAITI' to 90999, contributing to a total of $43 million raised by relief organizations like the Red Cross. A groundbreaking study by the Pew Internet and American Life Project explored the motivations behind this surge, interviewing 863 individuals who participated. Most said they acted on impulse, moved by vivid TV coverage rather than careful research. For 75% of them, it was their first time donating via text. Yet, their commitment to Haiti didn’t last: only a third gave again via text, and over half stopped following recovery efforts soon after. What’s striking, however, is that this experience changed their giving habits overall. More than half went on to donate by text to other disasters — including Japan’s 2011 tsunami (40%), the BP oil spill (27%), and U.S. tornado outbreaks (18%). These donors weren’t outliers; they were typical Americans, just more tech-savvy. Nearly a quarter owned e-readers, 82% had laptops, and 74% regularly used their phones to go online — rates far above the national average. Two-thirds were women and white, and more educated than the general population. Interestingly, the biggest driver of wider participation wasn’t Facebook or Twitter — it was face-to-face conversations. Over 40% of donors personally urged friends and family to give, and 76% of those efforts succeeded. Most encouraged others by talking in person (75%) or calling (38%), not texting or posting online. While text-to-give tools like mGive and MobileCause.org are now commonplace, the real power lies in human connection. As states like California and Maryland consider allowing political donations via text, regulators remain wary: the Federal Election Commission blocks such contributions to federal campaigns to preserve transparency. But pressure is mounting to find workarounds. One thing is clear: mobile giving isn’t just convenient — it’s contagious.

article_content: Fifteen-year-old Garrett Sebesta survived a shocking shark attack off Surfside Beach, Texas, by fighting back — grabbing the shark as it bit his leg and pulling it free. The incident happened in waist-deep water during a swim with friends from his church group. Despite sustaining a deep, seven-inch circular wound on his calf and significant nerve damage to his hand, Garrett remained conscious and alert throughout. His friends quickly pulled him from the water, and paramedics airlifted him to a Houston hospital, where he underwent emergency surgery. Medical staff described him as remarkably composed. 'He felt the bite, and just grabbed the shark and tore it off,' said medic Suandra Monnat. This marks the first shark attack in the region in over 20 years; locals typically worry more about jellyfish stings. Still, recent reports of sharks spotted — and even caught — in shallow waters nearby have prompted officials to urge swimmers to stay clear of fishing activity, as bait can attract predators. Garrett’s mother, Marina, confirmed his injuries but emphasized his resilience. 'He was a trooper,' she said.

article_content: (CNN) -- Disciplinary proceedings were launched Friday against Croatian international Josip Šimunić for allegedly leading pro-Nazi chants following his country’s qualification for the 2014 World Cup, FIFA confirmed. After Croatia’s 2-0 win over Iceland in a playoff match on Tuesday secured their place in Brazil, Šimunić grabbed a microphone at Zagreb’s Maksimir Stadium and loudly repeated 'za dom' — Croatian for 'for the homeland' — four times. Fans responded by chanting 'spremni,' meaning 'ready.' These chants are historically linked to the Ustaše regime, a fascist puppet state aligned with Nazi Germany during World War II that ruled Croatia and committed widespread atrocities. According to Croatian media, the 35-year-old Šimunić has been fined 25,000 kunas ($4,400) by Zagreb prosecutors for inciting racial hatred. FIFA stated: 'We can confirm that disciplinary proceedings have been opened concerning this case.' Šimunić, captain of Dinamo Zagreb, denied any political intent. 'The thought that anyone could associate me with any form of hatred or violence terrifies me,' he said in a statement on Dinamo’s official website. 'If anyone interpreted my cries differently — negatively — I hereby deny they carried any political context. They were driven solely by my love for my people and homeland, not hatred or destruction.' The veteran defender, who has played extensively in Germany’s Bundesliga, has represented Croatia since his 2001 debut. Both FIFA and UEFA have previously warned and fined Croatia for racist conduct by its supporters. The Croatian Football Federation also condemned Šimunić’s actions. President Davor Šuker called them 'an inappropriate gesture' and suggested further disciplinary measures. In September, Šimunić was involved in another controversy during Croatia’s World Cup qualifier against Serbia. With the score tied 1-1 and Croatia’s qualification hopes fading, he delivered a reckless tackle on Serbia’s Miralem Sulejmani, resulting in a red card. In other football news, UEFA fined both Marseille and Napoli for flare-related incidents during their Champions League encounters. Marseille received a €58,000 ($78,600) penalty after fans threw flares and objects onto the pitch during their home match on October 22 and the away leg on November 6. Napoli, who won both matches, was fined €55,000 ($74,500) for similar behavior by their supporters.

article_content: CNN) — California Governor Jerry Brown signed into law on Sunday a bill that prevents local governments from banning the practice of male circumcision. The legislation responds to an effort this summer by a San Francisco Bay Area advocacy group to place a citywide ban on the November 8 ballot. In July, a Superior Court judge ordered the measure removed, ruling that male circumcision is 'a widely practiced medical procedure' and that medical services fall under state regulation, not local authority. The law, which takes effect immediately, prohibits local and county governments from restricting male circumcision and declares that laws governing the practice must apply uniformly across the state.

article_content: New research suggests that even modest alcohol consumption might affect male fertility. A study involving 1,200 healthy young men in Denmark found that drinking just over three pints of beer per week—equivalent to about 7.5 alcohol units—was linked to lower sperm quality. Each pint typically contains around 2.3 units, but stronger lagers like Stella Artois pack in 2.7 units, meaning fewer than three pints could push men past the threshold. The more alcohol consumed, the worse the sperm looked: lower counts, more misshapen cells. Effects became especially pronounced at 37.5 units weekly—more than double the NHS’s recommended limit of 21–28 units. Surprisingly, men who drank absolutely nothing also showed reduced sperm quality compared to light drinkers, hinting that total abstinence may not be better. Researchers caution that while alcohol may directly harm sperm, it's also possible that men with existing fertility issues tend to drink more. Still, heavy or binge drinking clearly correlates with reproductive harm. Experts agree that occasional sips aren’t likely to ruin fertility, but regular heavy drinking should be avoided. With nearly half of UK infertility cases tied to male factors, and many couples spending thousands on IVF without success, the findings carry real-world weight—even if more studies are needed to untangle cause from correlation.

article_content: Queens Park Rangers owner Tony Fernandes has voiced strong confidence in midfielder Adel Taarabt, insisting he still has what it takes to shine in England’s top flight. Although Taarabt missed out on QPR’s recent pre-season trip to the United States, he’s worked his way back into manager Harry Redknapp’s considerations after showing glimpses of his old magic — notably in a standout performance during QPR’s Capital One Cup clash with Burton Albion. Fernandes believes Taarabt’s peak form — seen during his earlier years at Loftus Road — can be revived under the guidance of QPR’s coaching team, particularly first-team coach Glenn Hoddle. He described Taarabt as a classic 'QPR enigma': dazzling when focused, inconsistent when distracted. 'On his day, he’s unstoppable,' Fernandes told the Evening Standard. 'He’s shown in the Championship he belongs at this level.' Hoddle, known for his own flair-filled playing days, has taken a personal interest in nurturing Taarabt’s development. Fernandes revealed that QPR’s fitness team has flagged dietary habits as a barrier to consistency — noting Taarabt often eats poorly timed meals, much like Fernandes himself did in his youth. In response, the club is arranging a specialist nutritionist to help him reshape his routine. Taarabt recently messaged Fernandes expressing his determination: 'I want to show the world what I can do.' Since then, he’s been training intensely. Fernandes is convinced that if QPR can unlock his full potential, they’ll reap significant rewards — not just on the pitch, but in morale and fan engagement too.

article_content: Standing before judges in The Hague, former Liberian President Charles Taylor did not present himself as the first former head of state convicted of war crimes since World War II — but as a man wronged by corruption and selective justice. In his final address to the court before sentencing, Taylor pleaded for mercy, insisting his actions during Sierra Leone’s brutal civil war were intended to restore peace, not fuel terror. He expressed sorrow over last month’s guilty verdict, which found him guilty on all 11 counts of aiding and abetting the Revolutionary United Front (RUF), whose campaign of mutilation, rape, and child soldier recruitment left an estimated 50,000 dead or missing. Yet Taylor maintained his intent was honorable. 'What I did to bring peace to Sierra Leone was done with honor,' he declared, dressed impeccably in suit and tie — a consistent appearance throughout his trial. Unlike the volatile Ratko Mladic, whose trial opened the same day in another Hague tribunal, Taylor spoke calmly for 30 minutes, offering no apology. He accused the prosecution of being corrupted by money — alleging that millions in U.S. government funding influenced witness testimony and skewed the trial. 'Money prejudiced my rights in an irrevocable way,' he asserted. He drew a controversial parallel between his case and actions taken by the United States under President George W. Bush, noting that Bush had authorized controversial interrogation methods — including waterboarding — which critics labeled as torture. Bush publicly acknowledged these practices, yet faced no legal consequences. 'Is he above the law? Where is the fairness?' Taylor asked. He warned that other African leaders may face similar fates. 'I never stood a chance,' he said. 'Only time will tell how many other African heads of state will be destroyed.' The conviction is historic: the first by an international court since Nuremberg. While former Yugoslav President Slobodan Milosevic was tried, he died before a verdict. Taylor, 64, was found guilty of supporting atrocities — though not of directly commanding them. He was arrested in Nigeria in 2006 after fleeing Liberia in 2003 under international pressure. Chief Prosecutor Brenda Hollis argued for an 80-year sentence, stating: 'For Charles Taylor’s criminal conduct, thousands would not have had limbs amputated, would not have been raped, would not have been killed.' She called the sentence a necessary response to the victims’ suffering. In closing, Taylor appealed to his humanity: 'I am a father, a grandfather. I am no threat to society.' But few believe his words outweigh the evidence of his role in one of Africa’s most horrific conflicts. Sentencing is scheduled for May 30.

Erinevalt kõrvalekalletega Ratko Mladicist, kelle kohtuprotsess avati sama päeval teises Haagi tribunaalis, rääkis Taylor 30 minutit rahulikult, kuid ilma kahetsuseta. Ta hoiatas, et teised Aafrika juhid võivad kokku lõppeda samasugusesse kohtuprotsessi. 'Mul ei olnud kunagi võimalust,' ta ütles. 'Ainult aeg näitab, kui palju teisi Aafrika riigipeadi tappetakse.' Selle mõistmine on ajalooline: esimene kohtuotsus rahvusvahelisel tribunaalil teise maailmasõja järel. Kuigi endine Jugoslaavia presidendiks olnud Slobodan Milosevic oli kohtu alla võetud, suri ta enne kohtuotsust. Taylor, 64-aastane, leiti süüdi raskuste toetamises — kuid mitte nende käsutamises. Ta oli kinni peetud Nigeerias 2006. aastal pärast seda, kui ta oli 2003. aastal rahvusvahelise surve all Líberiast põgenenud. Peaprokurör Brenda Hollis palus 80-aastast vanglakaristust, öeldes: 'Charles Taylori kuritegude tõttu pole tuhandeid inimesi lõigatud, ei ole vägivaldselt rööbitud, ei ole tapetud.' Ta nimetas soovitud karistust vajalikuks reaktsiooniks ohvritele. Lõpus pöördus Taylor inimlikkuse poole: 'Ma olen isa ja vanaisa. Ma ei ole ühiskonna oht.' article_content: Jacob Spates, a formerly conjoined twin separated from his brother Joshua at just eight weeks old, has died at age two, according to Le Bonheur Children’s Hospital in Memphis. The cause of his death remains unclear. Jacob and Joshua were born on January 24, 2011, via cesarean section at the Regional Medical Center, joined at the pelvis and lower spine. They shared no vital organs — each had separate hearts, heads, and limbs. Due to the severity of Jacob’s congenital heart condition, the twins underwent a 13-hour surgical separation in 2011. While Joshua recovered quickly and was discharged home with their mother, Adrienne Spates, Jacob required prolonged intensive care and additional surgeries. In 2011, Dr. Max Langham, one of the lead surgeons, told TODAY: 'Joshua’s doing great, and hopefully he’ll be up and about with a normal lifespan. Although Jacob has more serious heart problems, our cardiology team has very high hopes his treatment will be successful.' He added, 'If they had not been separated, they likely would not have survived another year or two.' Adrienne Spates, a single mother of four, tearfully expressed joy when the twins saw each other for the first time post-surgery: 'I’m glad everyone gets to see my babies as separate people — because they are, and they have their own personalities.' In April 2012, the twins were placed under the custody of the Department of Child Services following their mother’s DUI arrest. It is currently unknown whether they remained in DCS care at the time of Jacob’s death. Conjoined twinning occurs in approximately 1 in 200,000 live births, with only about 15% sharing a similar pelvic attachment. Fewer than one-third survive beyond one day. Only about two dozen successful separations have been recorded globally. The surgical team at Le Bonheur prepared extensively, even using sewn-together Cabbage Patch dolls to practice untangling surgical lines during simulated separation procedures. Last week, another formerly conjoined twin, A’zhari Jones, died in Virginia just days after celebrating her first birthday alongside her sister, A’zhiah. It is not yet known whether her death was related to complications from their 2023 separation surgery.

Tema surmapõhjus on selgitamata. Jacob ja Joshua sündisid 24. jaanuaril 2011 segatud sektsiooniga Regional Medical Centeris, kus nad olid ühendatud külje ja alumise selja lihas. Neil ei olnud ühiseid elutähtsaid organid — igal neist oli eraldi süda, pea ja liikmed. Jacob'i tõsise südamehaiguse tõttu läbisid kaksikud 2011. aastal 13-tunnise kirurgilise eraldamise. Joshua taastus kiiresti ja sai luba minna koos emaga Adrienne Spatesega kodu, samas kui Jacob vajas pikemat intensiivravi ja lisatehinguid. 2011. aastal ütles üks juhtivaid kirurge, dr. Max Langham, TODAY-le: 'Joshua teeb suurepäraselt ja loodan, et ta saab tervelt ja normaalse eluea. Kuigi Jacobil on tõsisemad südameprobleemid, on meie kardioloogide rühmal väga kõrgeid ootusi tema ravi suhtes.' Ta lisas: 'Kui neid pole eraldatud, oleksid nad tõenäoliselt järgmise aasta või kahe jooksul surma saanud.' Adrienne Spates, nelja lapsedega üksikema, nutis, kui kaksikud nägid esimest korda teineteist pärast operatsiooni: 'Olen õnneline, et kõik saavad näha mu lapsi eraldatud inimestena — sest nad on, ja neil on oma iseloomud.' Aprillis 2012 paigutati kaksikud lapsekaitseameti valvuse alla pärast nende ema DUI-arresti. On seni teadmata, kas nad olid veel DCS valvuses Jacobi surma ajal. Ühendatud kaksikute sündimus toimub umbes 1 igale 200 000 sünnile, ja umbes 15% neist on ühendatud sarnaselt Joshua ja Jacobiga. Vähem kui kolmandik elab üle ühe päeva. Maailmas on edukalt eraldatud vaid umbes kaheksakümmend kaksikut. Le Bonheuri kirurgiline rühm valmistus täpselt, kasutades isegi ühendatud Cabbage Patch dollide, et praktiseerida operatsioonilise järjekorra simuleerimist ja eraldada operatsioonilised jooned. Viimasel nädalal surnud teine varem ühendatud kaksik, A’zhari Jones, Virginias, mõnda päeva pärast oma esimese sünnipäeva tähistamist koos oma õega, A’zhiahiga. On seni teadmata, kas tema surm oli seotud nende 2023. aasta eraldamisoperatsiooniga.

article_content: A routine police response turned into an unexpected crash when four Amish teenagers were arrested for underage drinking in rural New York. The incident occurred around 7:15 p.m. on Sunday on Clymer Hill Road in Sherman, near the Pennsylvania border, after a police patrol car arrived to investigate reports of teens consuming alcohol in horse-drawn buggies parked on secluded country roads. As the officer approached, one of the buggies suddenly changed lanes and collided with the patrol vehicle. The impact flipped the buggy onto its side, resulting in minor injuries to 19-year-old Marvin Byler, who was inside. He was arrested alongside 20-year-olds Marty Troyer and Leroy Troyer, and 18-year-old Marianne Troyer, who was also in the flipped buggy but escaped unharmed. Leroy Troyer, who was driving a second buggy, stopped after the crash and assisted. Police recovered multiple alcohol containers from the two buggies. Authorities believe several other buggies fled the scene. Marty Troyer was additionally charged with unlawfully dealing with a child, as he reportedly hosted the gathering. This incident highlights ongoing safety challenges for the Amish community, whose slow-moving buggies frequently share roads with fast-moving SUVs and trucks. Similar cases have occurred before: in July 2011, an Amish teen in Wango, New York, led police on a slow-speed chase after being spotted with an open beer container. In 2009, a man in Paradise, Pennsylvania, was arrested after being found asleep at the reins of his buggy with a blood-alcohol level of 0.18%.

article_content: In 1991, Nirvana shook the foundations of American rock with 'Nevermind'—an album featuring a naked baby reaching for a dollar bill on its cover. For many, it wasn’t just music; it was a cultural reset. Fred Thorne, who spent 18 years playing in bands, says Kurt Cobain’s legacy never left him. Today, that baby on the cover is a high school graduate—17 years old and stepping into adulthood, just like the generation Nirvana inspired. 'Nevermind' surged to No. 1 on the Billboard charts, abruptly ending the reign of 1980s hair metal and dance-pop. In its place rose grunge: raw, honest, and unapologetically dark. Russ Lancaster, reflecting on 'Smells Like Teen Spirit,' compares Nirvana’s impact to that of the Beatles decades earlier. 'They stopped singing about happy, catchy tunes,' he says. 'They turned pop music inward—to pain, confusion, and anger. And suddenly, that was everywhere on the radio.' That shift opened the floodgates. Bands like Pearl Jam found audiences. The emo genre took root. Indie rock—once confined to college radio and tape-trading friends—became part of the mainstream. Pat Ferguson credits 'Nevermind' for making obscure indie bands like Dinosaur Jr., Sebadoh, and Superchunk accessible. 'Before iTunes or Napster, you had to live near a campus station or know someone who did,' he recalls. 'Grunge made it possible for music like that to reach us.' For Derek Ivy, hearing Nirvana as a teen sparked a lifelong passion. 'They taught me how to play guitar,' he says. 'I learned every song. When Kurt died, I felt like I’d lost a friend—even though I’d never met him. At 14, it was my first real taste of adulthood.' Fred Thorne channeled Cobain’s ethos into his own performances: 'Be careful what you wish for.' He played for ten people in smoky bars like it was his last show—no perfect pitch, no fancy gear, no record deal. 'I played for Kurt,' he says. 'For the guy who just wanted to make noise and be heard.' But not everyone celebrated. David Gillespie laments the end of the '80s golden age. 'Grunge killed the best music,' he writes. 'Nirvana wasn’t technically gifted—and they didn’t need to be. That was the problem.' Amy Suarez offers perspective: 'Everyone thinks the music of their youth was the best. Nirvana meant everything to me. To others? Nothing. It’s just timing.' More than three decades later, 'Nevermind' remains a landmark—not because it was perfect, but because it was real. And for millions, that was enough.

'Nad tõid popmuusika sisse—valu, segaduse ja viha. Ja järsult oli see kõik raadios.' See muutus avas uksed. Bändid nagu Pearl Jam leidsid kuulajaid. Emo žanr sai aluse. Indie rokk—mis oli varem piiratud ülikooliraadioga ja kassettidega—muutus peamiseks. 'Enne iTunesi või Napsterit tuli elada lähedal ülikooliraadiole või teada keegi, kes sellele juurde pääses,' ta mäletab. 'Grunge tegi võimalikuks, et selline muusika jõuaks meieni.' Derek Ivy jaoks tõi Nirvana kuulmine nooruses pikaajalise rõõmu. 'Nad õpetasid mind kitarrile mängima,' ütleb ta. 'Ma õppisin kõiki laule. Kui Kurt suri, tundus, et ma kaotasin sõbra—kuigi ma teda kunagi ei olnud näinud. 14-aastasena oli see minu esimene tõeline mõistmine täiskasvanu elust.' Fred Thorne kasutas Cobaini filosoofiat oma esinemistes: 'Ole ettevaatlik, mida soovid.' Ta mängis kümnele inimesele suitsetavas baaris nagu see oleks tema viimane esitus—pole täpset heli, pole kallit seadmeid, pole lepingut. 'Ma mängisin Kurti eest,' ütleb ta. 'Selle inimese eest, kes tahtis lihtsalt muusikat teha ja kuuldavaks saada.' Aga mitte kõik olid rahul. David Gillespie lamenteerib 1980. aastate kulminatsiooni lõppu. 'Grunge tapis parima muusika,' kirjutab ta. 'Nirvana ei olnud tehniliselt osav—ja neil seda ei vajanud. See oli probleem.' Amy Suarez pakub vaatenurka: 'Igaüks arvab, et tema noorsuse muusika oli parim. Nirvana tähendas mulle kõike. Teistele? Midagi. See on lihtsalt ajastu.' Üle kolme aastakümne pärast jääb 'Nevermind' mälestuseks—mitte sellepärast, et see oli täiuslik, vaid sellepärast, et see oli tõene. Ja miljonitele see piisas.

article_content: Students who feel they have been victimized because of social characteristics such as their ethnicity or sexuality are at increased risk of trauma, according to a new national U.S. study published in the Journal of School Violence. The research, which surveyed more than 2,200 young victims of bullying, found that students who believed bias motivated the attacks reported worse outcomes in their physical health, self-esteem, social relationships, and schoolwork compared to those who did not perceive bias. These effects were especially pronounced among students who felt targeted for multiple characteristics. The findings conclude that schools’ anti-bullying and violence prevention programs should place greater emphasis on identifying and addressing bias-based victimization, and staff should be trained to recognize students at heightened risk. ‘This study adds to the rising tide of evidence demonstrating that adolescent victimization motivated by bias is uniquely impactful,’ says Allison Kurpiel, a Ph.D. candidate in sociology and criminology at Pennsylvania State University. 'Victimization involving multiple bias types appears to be especially influential.' Students who experienced biased victimization were also more likely than non-biased victims to report negative effects on their schoolwork—a pattern observed across academic performance levels. The study analyzed data from the 2017 and 2019 School Crime Supplement to the National Crime Victimization Survey, a nationally representative household survey conducted every two years in the United States. Participants were asked whether they had been subjected to behaviors such as name-calling, rumor-spreading, threats, physical aggression, exclusion, or property destruction in the past year. Those who reported victimization were further asked if they believed these incidents were related to their race, religion, ethnic background, disability, gender, sexual orientation, or physical appearance. Approximately 25% of students reported being victimized in the past year; of those, 40% believed bias played a role. Among bias-identified victims, physical appearance was the most frequently cited reason—cited by roughly 30%—followed by gender and sexual orientation. The most common forms of victimization were threats and rumor-spreading, each affecting about two-thirds of victims. Students who perceived bias reported experiencing a broader range of victimization types than those who did not. Negative effects on self-esteem were the most commonly reported consequence, affecting over 25% of victims, while physical health impacts were the least common, affecting fewer than one in seven. Victims who perceived bias were three times more likely to suffer negative effects on self-esteem and had significantly higher odds of harm to their physical health, social relationships, and schoolwork. Each additional type of bias reported increased the likelihood of negative schoolwork outcomes by 70%. Girls and students with lower grades were more likely to experience all four negative effects. 'Peer aggression involving prejudice causes additional harm and can threaten schools' abilities to create inclusive learning environments,' Kurpiel adds. Her recommendations include raising awareness and targeting prevention programs toward students facing intersecting vulnerabilities. One promising intervention is expanding inclusive school organizations like Gay-Straight Alliance clubs, which have been shown to reduce bias-based bullying among LGBTQ+ female students. The study acknowledges limitations: not all potential impacts (e.g., risky behavior) were measured, and school climate factors such as support group availability were not accounted for due to data constraints.
translated_content: Õppijad, kes tunnevad, et nad on saanud kannatada sotsiaalsete omaduste, nagu nende etniline taust või seksuaalne orientatsioon, tõttu, on suuremas ohtus traumast, näitab uus USA riiklik uuring, mis on avaldatud ajakirjas 'Journal of School Violence'. Uuring, mis hõlmas üle 2200 noore, kellele oli süüdistatud, leidis, et õpilased, kes uskusid, et nende kurjategijate tegud olid seotud eelarvamustega, kogesid halvemaid tulemusi füüsilises tervises, enesehinnangus, sotsiaalsetes suhetes ja koolitöös kui need, kes ei pidanud eelarvamusi tegu põhjuseks. Need mõjud olid eriti märgatavad neil õpilastel, kes arvasid, et neid diskrimineeriti mitme omaduse tõttu. Järeldused jätavad, et koolide vastuvõtlikkuse ja vägivalla ennetamise programmidele tuleb suunata rohkem tähelepanu eelarvamuste põhjustatud kannatuste tuvastamisele ja lahendamisele ning õpetajatel tuleb õppida tuvastama neid õpilasi, kes on suuremas ohus. 'See uuring lisab tõendite kasvavale voole, mis näitavad, et noorte kannatamine, mis on motiveeritud eelarvamustega, on eriline mõju,' ütleb autor Allison Kurpiel, kes on Pennsylvania Ülikooli sotsioloogia ja kriminoloogia doktorant. 'Kannatamine, mis hõlmab mitut eelarvamuse tüüpi, tundub olevat eriti mõjukas.' Õpilased, kes kogesid eelarvamuste põhjustatud kannatust, olid ka rohkem tõenäoline kui mittesiduselt kannatanud õpilased, et märkida negatiivseid mõjusid oma koolitööl — see seos oli täheldatav kõigi akadeemiliste tasemete õpilaste seas. Uuring analüüsib andmeid 2017. ja 2019. aasta koolivõimlemise lisast USA Riiklikule Kurjategemise Ohverduse Uuringule, mis on kahel aastal korraldatav riiklikult esindav kodude uuring. Õpilased küsiti, kas viimase aasta jooksul keegi oli neid naeratavalt nimetatud, rääkinud nende vastu halva, levitanud kuulujuttu, püüdnud teisi neile vastu saada, ähvardanud, tõstnud, lasknud jalgsi, kõrvale püüdnud või püüdnud sundida neid tegema asju, mida nad ei soovinud, nt raha andmist. Nad küsiti ka, kas neid oli teadlikult välja jäetud või kas nende vara oli teadlikult purustatud. Need, kes ütlesid, et nad olid kohanud ühe või mitme sellise käitumisega, küsiti, kas nad uskusid, et see oli seotud nende raskega, usuga, etnilise taustaga, puuetega, soo või seksuaalse orientatsiooniga või füüsilise välimusega. Nad jagati kahte rühma: need, kes uskusid, et nende kogemus oli seotud eelarvamustega, ja need, kes ütlesid, et mitte. Uuring analüüsib kannatanute mõjusid ja küsis, kas need, kes uskusid, et neil oli rohkem kui üks tüüp eelarvamust, olid tõenäolisemalt kannatanud kahjulike tagajärgede all kui need, kes said ainult ühe. Uuring leidis, et umbes veerand kõigist õpilastest oli viimase aasta jooksul kannatanud, ja nendest umbes neljast kümnest tundis, et tegud olid motiveeritud eelarvamustega. Kõige sagedasem eelarvamus — umbes kolm kümnest neist, kes uskusid, et eelarvamus oli tegur — oli seotud füüsilise välimusega. Kõige sagedasemad kannatuste vormid olid ähvardamine ja kuulujuttude levitamine, mida koges umbes kaks kolmandikku kannatanutest. Üldiselt tundsid õpilased, kes olid eelarvamuste ohvrid, et nad olid kogenud laiemat kannatuste spektrit kui need, kes ei tunnenud seda. Negatiivsed mõjud enesehinnakule olid kõige sagedasemad ja neid koges üle veerandi kannatanutest, samas kui füüsilise tervise mõjud olid kõige haruldasemad ja neid koges vähem kui üks seitse. Uuring leidis, et need, kes tundsid, et nende kannatamine oli seotud eelarvamustega, olid kolm korda tõenäolisemad kahjulike mõjude kohta enesehinnakule ja olid suuremad tõenäosused kahjustustele füüsilisele tervisele, sotsiaalsetele suhetele ja koolitööle. Need, kes tundsid, et nad said mitme tüübi eelarvamust, olid suuremad tõenäosused kogeda kõiki nelja mõjutatud valdkonda. Näiteks igasugune lisatud eelarvamuse tüüp tõstis tõenäosust raportida negatiivseid mõjusid koolitööl 70%. Tüdrukud olid tõenäolisemad kui poisid kogeda kõiki nelja negatiivset mõju, samuti need, kes olid madalamal hindega. 'Sõprade agressioon, mis sisaldab eelarvamusi, põhjustab lisakahju ja võib ohustada koolide võimet luua sisaldavaid õppekeskkondi,' lisab Kurpiel. Ta soovitab, et koolid peaksid 'suurendama teadlikkust nendest probleemidest' ja et ennetamise programmide tuleks eriti suunata õpilaste tuvastamisele, kes on ohus mitme teguri tõttu. 'Üks potentsiaalne interventsioon on suurendada kooli organisatsioone, mis edendavad sisaldavust, nagu Gay–Straight Alliance klubid, mis on tõestatud efektiivseteks mitmete eelarvamuste põhjustatud hädade vähendamisel naistel, kes identifitseeruvad LGBT-ina,' ta ütleb. Artikli tulemusi tuleb hinnata arvestades mõningate piirangutega. Näiteks ei mõõdetud kõiki võimalikke kannatuste mõjusid, seega 'eelarvamuste põhjustatud kannatamine ei pruugi olla seotud suuremate tõenäosustega mõjudega kui mittesiduselt kannatanud tulemuste jaoks mõned mõõtmatud tulemused (nt riskantne käitumine),' uuring ütleb. Kooli ilminguga seotud tegurid, mis võiksid olla olulised eelarvamuste põhjustatud kannatuste mõjude mõistmiseks (nt toetusgrupid), ei ole arvestatud, kuna nende puudumine andmetes.

article_content: As nearly 1.7 million Afghans are ordered to leave Pakistan, the streets remain eerily silent—no protests, no public outcry. In cities like Lahore, Karachi, and Islamabad, the absence of Afghan workers—once common as street vendors, garbage collectors, and laborers—is now striking. Since November 1, Pakistan’s government has enforced a sweeping crackdown on undocumented migrants, targeting nearly 1.7 million Afghans among an estimated 4 million refugees in the country. Raza Ali, a 31-year-old air conditioning technician in Lahore, expressed indifference. 'They weren’t my friends, but they were always there,' he said. 'Now they’re gone. Maybe it’s better for us—they weren’t from here anyway.' His attitude reflects a broader public sentiment: quiet approval. A Gallup Pakistan poll found 84% of respondents strongly support the expulsion, with 64% believing it will improve national security. The government blames Afghan refugees for a surge in attacks by the Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), claiming 14 of 24 suicide bombings this year were carried out by Afghan nationals. Over 300,000 Afghans have reportedly left since November, despite condemnation from the UN and human rights groups. Yet, critics warn this is not just a security issue—it’s a moral failure. Sociologist Nida Kirmani of LUMS argues that decades of state-sponsored propaganda have painted Afghans as ‘terrorists,’ even as Pakistan’s own institutions once nurtured the Taliban. 'Afghans are convenient scapegoats during times of economic stress,' she said. Lawyer Sara Malkani points out that many expelled Afghans were born in Pakistan and have never set foot in Afghanistan. Now, they’re being returned to a country under Taliban rule, where girls are barred from school, women from working, and basic freedoms erased. 'Deporting them is sending people to a living nightmare,' she said. While some civil society voices resist, fear of state repression stifles mass protest. Experts say changing public perception requires confronting Pakistan’s own history—and recognizing the humanity of those now being cast out.

article_content: The UK Ministry of Defence (MoD) has awarded a £46 million contract for 51 new Foxhound light patrol vehicles to support British troops in Afghanistan. Defence Minister Philip Dunne announced the deal during a visit to General Dynamics Land Systems’ facility in Telford, where the vehicles are manufactured and maintained. The Foxhound replaces the outdated Snatch Land Rover, which was dangerously vulnerable to roadside bombs used by insurgents in Iraq and Afghanistan. Designed with a V-shaped hull and cutting-edge Formula 1-inspired technology, the Foxhound offers superior protection against improvised explosive devices (IEDs). Capable of reaching 80mph and continuing to operate even after losing three wheels following an IED blast, the vehicle features a rapidly replaceable engine—swap-ready in just 30 minutes. First deployed earlier this year, the Foxhounds are now actively supporting British soldiers mentoring Afghan National Security Forces. The MoD says the project took just 40 months from design to fielding—an unusually fast turnaround for military hardware. This latest order brings the total number of Foxhounds in service to 376, as part of a £340 million investment since 2010. The contract is expected to safeguard jobs at the Telford spares depot, the company’s headquarters in Leamington Spa, and across the UK’s defence supply chain. Minister Dunne emphasized the vehicle’s versatility and long-term value, calling it a ‘procurement success story’ and a key contributor to both operational effectiveness and regional economic stability.

article_content: Pakistan has set a hard deadline of November 1, 2023, for approximately 1.73 million Afghan nationals living without official documentation to leave the country—or risk forced deportation. Interior Minister Sarfraz Bugti justified the move by claiming that Afghan citizens were behind 14 of the 24 suicide bombings in Pakistan this year, asserting that these individuals have no legal right to remain. However, official UN data shows that out of an estimated 4.4 million Afghans in Pakistan, over 2.18 million hold some form of recognized status, including registered refugees or those with legal permits. The remainder, including families who settled decades ago during the Soviet-Afghan War, now find themselves caught in a sudden policy shift. Many, like 57-year-old fruit vendor Fazal Rehman in Peshawar, say they’ve never seen the need to register—his children were born in Pakistan and have never set foot in Afghanistan. Now, with passport applications in Afghanistan backed up for months and visa processing equally slow, compliance is nearly impossible. The Afghan Embassy in Islamabad condemned the crackdown as harassment, reporting that over 1,000 Afghans—including those legally present—have been detained in just two weeks. Authorities also threaten to seize properties and shut down businesses owned by Afghans. Critics argue the policy ignores the reality of decades-long coexistence and punishes vulnerable populations for systemic failures in both countries’ immigration oversight.

article_content: Gurbaksh Chahal, the multimillionaire tech CEO accused of violently assaulting his girlfriend 117 times in a 30-minute attack, has filed a police report claiming he is being harassed by an 'obsessed female fan.' The 31-year-old, who was fired as CEO of online advertising firm RadiumOne amid public outcry over his domestic violence charges, submitted the report to the Spartanburg Police Department in South Carolina on June 13. In the report, Chahal described himself as a public figure living in San Francisco and named 28-year-old accountant Parveen Bining as the suspect, alleging she has been sending unwanted emails to his sister, Kamal Chahal, and close friend Laura Bae in an attempt to interfere with his personal and professional life. Bining, who has not met Chahal, denied the harassment claims in an interview with The Smoking Gun, stating she had exchanged messages with him via Facebook two years prior but has not contacted him since. Chahal was originally charged with 45 felony counts for the 2013 assault on his girlfriend in his San Francisco penthouse. Surveillance footage captured the attack, but it was ruled inadmissible in court because police obtained it without a warrant. The victim later withdrew her cooperation. Chahal ultimately pleaded guilty to one count of domestic violence battery and one count of simple battery. He received a sentence of 25 hours of community service, three years of probation, and completion of a 52-week domestic violence program. RadiumOne terminated Chahal in April 2014 after TechCrunch publicly condemned him as a 'violent, angry man' and dropped its sponsorship of the Disrupt NY conference. Leena Rao, a senior editor at TechCrunch, wrote an open letter criticizing society for allowing abusive individuals to thrive without accountability. Despite the conviction and public backlash, Chahal continued to work as a motivational speaker and post inspirational content online, including messages like '15 Things Leaders Never Do' and 'When you want to succeed as bad as you want to breathe, then you'll be successful.' Chahal, who sold his first company, ClickAgents, for $40 million at age 18 and later sold BlueLithium to Yahoo! for $300 million in 2007, has been featured on Oprah Winfrey’s show and named 'America’s Most Eligible Bachelor' by Extra TV. Spartanburg police confirmed they are still investigating Bining’s alleged harassment, and no charges have been filed against her. MailOnline was unable to reach her for comment.

article_content: A popular American fast-food restaurant is asking customers to 'Eat Mor Chikin'—without antibiotics. Chick-fil-A Inc. announced Tuesday that it plans to serve only chicken raised without antibiotics in all of its restaurants within five years. National and regional poultry suppliers are partnering with the company to meet this goal, working closely with the U.S. Department of Agriculture to ensure compliance. "Since our family business began 67 years ago, we have focused on our customers. It's why we insist on using the highest-quality ingredients," said Dan Cathy, president and CEO of Chick-fil-A. "We want to continue that heritage, and offering antibiotic-free chicken is the next step." Chick-fil-A is a privately held company with 1,700 locations across 39 states and Washington, D.C., and describes itself as the second-largest quick-service chicken restaurant chain in the United States. The company reported $5 billion in sales in 2013. Why does this matter? Antibiotics are commonly used in livestock to prevent disease and promote growth. In 2011, approximately 29.9 million pounds of antibiotics were sold for meat and poultry production—compared to just 7.7 million pounds for human use, according to the Pew Charitable Trusts. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration warns that such use contributes to the rise of antibiotic-resistant bacteria. Many antibiotics given to animals are also critical for treating human infections. In December 2013, the FDA unveiled a plan to phase out non-therapeutic antibiotic use in food-producing animals. 'Because all uses of antimicrobial drugs—in both humans and animals—contribute to resistance, it is important to use them only when medically necessary,' the agency stated. The National Chicken Council called Chick-fil-A’s move a 'business decision,' noting that many of its members already offer antibiotic-free poultry options. 'Antibiotics are not always used in chicken production; they are administered under veterinary supervision to prevent or treat disease,' said Ashley Peterson, the council’s vice president of scientific and regulatory affairs. 'Science shows that responsible, judicious use of FDA-approved antibiotics is both safe and effective.' Chick-fil-A has previously revised its ingredients—removing yellow dye from its chicken soup and testing alternatives to artificial additives in buns and high-fructose corn syrup in dressings. These changes followed pressure from food blogger Vani Hari, known as the 'Food Babe,' who wrote critically about the company’s ingredients in 2012. Hari later met with Chick-fil-A executives for four hours, and the company responded by initiating ingredient reviews. Her advocacy has also influenced other brands: Subway removed azodicarbonamide—a chemical also found in yoga mats—from its bread, and Kraft eliminated Yellow No. 5 and Yellow No. 6 dyes from select Macaroni & Cheese products, including themed packaging featuring SpongeBob, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and How to Train Your Dragon 2. Meanwhile, a petition led by concerned mother Renee Shutters and the Center for Science in the Public Interest is urging Mars Inc. to remove artificial dyes from M&M’s candies—an effort inspired by the fact that European versions already do without them.

"Me tahame jätkata seda pärandit ja antibiootikumideta taližoodi pakumine on järgmine samm." Ettevõte teatas 2013. aastal 5 miljardi dollari müügist. Miks see oluline on? Antibiootikume kasutatakse tihti loomade hoidmisel haiguste ennetamiseks ja loomade kasvu kiirendamiseks. 2011. aastal müüdi umbes 29,9 miljonit naela antibiootikume lihakasvatuseks ja linnuliha tootmiseks—võrreldes ainult 7,7 miljoniga inimeste ravimiseks, nagu Pew Charitable Trusts teatas. Ameerika Ühendriikide Tervishoiu- ja Ravimiamet (FDA) hoiatab, et selline kasutus aitab kaasa antibiootikumiresistentsuse tõusule. 'Kuna kõik antimikroobsete ravimite kasutused—nii inimestel kui ka loomadel—panevad panuse resistentsuse arengusse, on oluline kasutada neid ainult meditsiiniliselt vajalikul juhul,' ütles amet. Ameerika Linnuliha Nõukogu nimetas Chick-fil-A sammu 'ettevõteline otsus', märkides, et paljud selle liikmed pakuvad juba antibiootikumideta linnuliha valikuid. 'Antibiootikume ei kasutata alati linnuliha tootmisel; neid antakse veterinääri järelevalve all haiguste ennetamiseks ja ravimiseks,' ütles nõukogu teaduslike ja regulatiivsete asjade osakonna vanemjuht Ashley Peterson. 'Teadaus näitab, et vastutustundlik ja mõistlik kasutus FDA-lubatud antibiootikume on nii turvaline kui tõhus.' Chick-fil-A on eelnevalt muutnud oma sisendaineid—eemaldanud kollase värvi oma taližoodi supist ja testimisel alternatiive kunstlike lisainainete ja kõrge fruktoosise siirapi kasutamiseks sookides ja sosides. Need muudatused tulid pärast toidublogija Vani Hari, tuntud kui 'Food Babe', kriitilisi kirjutusi ettevõtte toodetest 2012. aastal. Hari kohtus hiljem Chick-fil-A juhtidega nelja tunni jooksul, ja ettevõte vastas sellele, et alustas sisendainete läbivaatamist. Tema advokaatsioon on mõjutanud ka teisi brändide: Subway eemaldas azodicarbonamiidi—keemilise aine, mis leidub ka yogamatidest—oma leibadest, ja Kraft eemaldas kollase värvi nr 5 ja nr 6 valikulistest makaroni ja juustust, sealhulgas SpongeBob, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles ja 'How to Train Your Dragon 2' pakenditega. article_content: Later this week, SpaceX is set to attempt its highly anticipated second test flight of the Starship megarocket — if it receives final regulatory clearance. Here’s what you need to know about this pivotal mission. Elon Musk’s company is targeting Friday, November 17 for the launch, pending approval from federal regulators. This follows the first test on April 20, which ended in the rocket’s destruction over the Gulf of Mexico. Since then, SpaceX has completed 63 corrective actions required by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). Standing 400 feet (122 meters) tall, Starship is the most powerful rocket ever built. It is central to SpaceX’s ambitions for deep-space exploration, including crewed missions to Mars, and plays a vital role in NASA’s Artemis lunar program by enabling more affordable, high-capacity spaceflight. The first flight exposed numerous flaws — Musk noted in June that over a thousand modifications were needed. One major issue was the lack of protective infrastructure at the Boca Chica launchpad. The combined force of 33 Raptor engines firing for eight seconds destroyed the launch mount, hurling debris across the site. In response, SpaceX installed a water-cooled steel flame deflector and a new deluge system to absorb the blast energy. This system is now under review by the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service and the FAA for potential environmental effects — the last regulatory hurdle before launch. Choosing November 17 as the target date suggests SpaceX expects approval imminently — or is strategically pressuring regulators. Another critical fix involved the rocket’s self-destruct system, which failed to activate promptly during the first flight. SpaceX has since improved its responsiveness. A major technical upgrade is the implementation of 'hot-stage separation': igniting the Starship upper stage’s engines before separating from the booster. This avoids the instability that led to the first flight’s catastrophic spin. Additionally, a new electronic Thrust Vector Control (TVC) system has been added to the Super Heavy booster’s Raptor engines for better steering precision. Propellant loading — liquid oxygen and liquid methane — begins 1 hour and 37 minutes before liftoff. At T-minus 19 minutes and 40 seconds, the engines begin an 'engine chill' to prepare them for cryogenic fuels. The flame deflector activates at T-minus 10 seconds, and ignition now occurs at T-minus 3 seconds — reduced from T-minus 8 — to lessen ground damage. Liftoff occurs two seconds after ignition. Max Q — peak aerodynamic stress — is expected at 52 seconds. At 2 minutes and 30 seconds, 'MECO' (Most Engines Cut Off) triggers, shutting down most Raptor engines. At 2 minutes and 53 seconds, the booster performs a 'boostback burn,' flipping and initiating its return toward the Gulf of Mexico for a simulated splashdown around the seven-minute mark. This is a rehearsal for future vertical landings at Boca Chica. Meanwhile, the Starship upper stage continues upward, cutting its engines at 8 minutes and 33 seconds. It will fly over the Caribbean, southern Africa, the Indian Ocean, and New Guinea before planning a controlled ocean landing near Hawaii at approximately 90 minutes. A critical reentry phase occurs at 1 hour and 17 minutes. Importantly, Starship will not complete a full Earth orbit on this flight. Success hinges on several milestones: whether the water deluge system prevents launchpad damage, if all 33 engines ignite correctly, whether hot staging works on the first try, and whether Starship survives atmospheric reentry. SpaceX anticipates setbacks — it embraces 'rapid iterative development,' the philosophy behind its successes with Falcon, Dragon, and Starlink. Even if this flight fails, it will provide invaluable data for the next attempt. One thing is certain: the second Starship test will be anything but boring.
translated_content: Järgmisel nädalal on SpaceX valmis esitama oma Starship megaroketi teise testimise lendu — kui see saab viimase regulatiivse heakskiidu. Siin on mida te peate teadma selle olulise missiooni kohta. Elon Muski juhitud ettevõte planeerib lendu reede, 17. novembril, kuni reguleerivad asutused annavad lõpliku luba. See järgneb esimesele testimisele 20. aprillil, mis lõppes raketi hävimisega Meksiko lahes. Alates sellest ajast on SpaceX täidetud 63 parandusmeetmet, mille nõudis USA Lennundusamet (FAA). 400 jalga (122 meetrit) kõrge Starship on kõige tugevam rakett, mis kunagi on ehitatud. See on keskne SpaceX-i kavanditele sügavaaegsete missioonide jaoks, sealhulgas kruusikutele Marssi, ning see mängib olulist rolli NASA Artemisi kuukavandis, võimaldades odavamaid ja suurema kapatsiteediga lenne. Esimesel lendul avastati palju puudusi — Musk ütles juunis, et vaja oli üle tuhande muudatuse. Üks suur probleem oli puuduv kaitseinfrastruktuur Boca Chica lennujaamas. 33 Raptor mootori kooskõlas kaheksa sekundi pikkuse põlemisega purustasid lennujaama, kippides kõikide kohalike aladele. Vastuseks paigaldas SpaceX veejahutusega terasest plaatidega plahvatuskaitse ja uue veeväljastussüsteemi, et neelata plahvatusenergiat. Seda süsteemi vaatavad täpselt USA Kalakaitse ja Loomakaitse Teenistus ja FAA potentsiaalse keskkonnamõju tõttu — see on viimane regulatiivne takistus enne lendu. Novembri 17. kuupäeva valimine viitab sellele, et SpaceX ootab lube kiiresti — või proovib rõhku avaldada regulatiivsetele asutustele. Teine oluline parandus oli raketi iseõnnetuse süsteem, mis ei aktiveerunud esimesel lendul kiiresti. SpaceX on selle reageerimiskiirust parandanud. Suur tehniline uuendus on 'soojast eraldamise' rakendamine: Starship ülemise astme mootorite süttimine enne eraldumist alumisest astmest. See vältib eelmise lendu kahjulikku spinni, mis põhjustas katastroofi. Lisaks on Super Heavy Raptor mootoritele paigaldatud uus elektrooniline jõu vektori kontrolli (TVC) süsteem parema juhtimise täpsuse jaoks. Kütuse laadimine — vedel hapnik ja vedel metaan — algab 1 tund ja 37 minutit enne lennu. T-miinus 19 minutit ja 40 sekundit hakkavad mootorid 'jäätmise protsessi', et valmistuda kriitiliste kütuste jaoks. Plahvatuskaitse aktiveerub T-miinus 10 sekundit, ja süttimine toimub nüüd T-miinus 3 sekundit — vähendatuna T-miinus 8 sekundist — et vähendada lennujaama kahjustust. Lend algab kaks sekundit pärast süttimist. Max Q — maksimaalne aerodünaamiline survet — oodatakse 52 sekundi pärast. 2 minutit ja 30 sekundit pärast lennu algust toimub 'MECO' (peaaegu kõigi mootorite peatamine), mis lülitab välja suurema osa Raptor mootoreid. 2 minutit ja 53 sekundit pärast lennu algust teeb booster 'tagasipöördeploki', keerates ja alustades tagasipöördumist Meksiko lahe poole, et simuleerida veepõhja maandumist umbes seitsme minuti jooksul. See on ettevalmistus tulevaste vertikaalsete maandumiste jaoks Boca Chicas. Samal ajal jätkab Starship ülemine astme oma lennu, lülitades mootorid välja 8 minutit ja 33 sekundit pärast lennu algust. See lendab Karibaani, Lõuna-Aafrika, India ookeani ja Uus-Guinea kaudu, enne kavandatud veepõhja maandumist Lähedal Hawaii uues, umbes 90 minuti jooksul. Kriitiline faas on atmosfääri sisenemine 1 tunni ja 17 minuti pärast. Oluline on märkida, et Starship ei tee seda lendul täielikku ringi Maa ümber. Edu sõltub mitmetest olulistest punktidest: kas veeväljastussüsteem takistab lennujaama kahjustust, kas kõik 33 mootorit süttivad õigesti, kas soojast eraldamine töötab esimesel katse ja kas Starship talub atmosfääri sisenemise. SpaceX ootab raskusi — ta on vastuvõtnud 'kiire iteratiivse arenduse' filosoofia, mis on olnud alus kõigile SpaceX-i suurtele innovatsioonidele, sealhulgas Falcon, Dragon ja Starlink. Isegi kui see lend ebaõnnestub, annab see väärtuslikke andmeid järgmisele katsele. Üks asi on kindel: teine Starship test ei ole mingil juhul igav.
