article_content: During Thursday night’s vice presidential debate, Republican congressional candidate Paul Ryan raised alarms about Iran’s nuclear program, claiming that since President Obama took office, Iran has gone from having enough fissile material for one nuclear bomb to enough for five. He asserted that Iran is 'racing toward a nuclear weapon' and is 'four years closer' to achieving it — blaming the current administration for lacking credibility on the issue. Democratic Vice President Joe Biden pushed back, dismissing Ryan’s statements as 'bluster' and 'loose talk.' He emphasized that international sanctions are severely impacting Iran’s economy and that both U.S. and Israeli intelligence agencies assess Iran is still 'a good way away' from developing a nuclear bomb. Fact-checking reveals that Iran has indeed expanded its nuclear infrastructure significantly over the past four years. In 2009, it revealed a second uranium enrichment facility and continues to defy U.N. demands to suspend activities until questions about its intentions are resolved. Technically, producing a nuclear weapon requires enriching uranium-235 to over 90% — far beyond the 3–5% needed for power plants or the 20% used in research reactors. According to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), as of May, Iran possessed approximately 6,200 kilograms of low-enriched uranium and 146 kilograms enriched to 20%. The Institute for Science and International Security (ISIS), led by former U.N. inspector David Albright, estimates this stockpile could be further enriched to produce enough weapons-grade material for five nuclear bombs. However, ISIS also notes that converting 20%-enriched uranium into weapons-grade material would take more than two months, and starting from low-enriched uranium would take several months — giving the international community time to detect and respond. Building a functional nuclear weapon involves more than fissile material. ISIS estimates Iran would need many additional months to design a testable device, and even longer to miniaturize a warhead capable of being delivered by a ballistic missile. While the IAEA has confirmed Iran has not diverted any declared uranium stockpiles, it has repeatedly criticized Tehran for failing to provide full transparency. Iran insists its program is entirely peaceful, while Israel accuses it of secretly pursuing nuclear weapons — raising fears of a potential military strike. U.S. intelligence, as stated by Director of National Intelligence James Clapper in January, concludes that Iran is 'keeping open the option' to develop nuclear weapons but has not yet made a decision to do so.
translated_content: Neljapäevase varabinde-debati ajal tõstis Vabariikliku kongressiliikme Paul Ryani esile Iraani tuumaprogrammi kohta muresid, väites, et alates presidendi Obama valimisest on Iraan olnud suuteline teha ühe tuumapommi asemel viis. Ta väitis, et Iraan 'sõidab tuumapommide poole' ja on 'nelja aasta võrra lähemal' selle saavutamisele, pannes süüdistuse praegusele valitsusele, et see puudub usaldusväärsuses selle küsimuses. Demokraatlik varabinde Joe Biden vastutas, hüüdes Ryani sõnu 'tühjaks kõnelemiseks' ja 'lõdvalt rääkimiseks'. Ta rõhutas, et rahvusvahelised sanktsioonid mõjutavad Iraani majandust tõsiselt ja et USA ning Iisraeli teadusasutused arvavad, et Iraan on veel 'palju kaugel' tuumapommide loomisest. Faktide kontroll näitab, et Iraan on viimaste nelja aasta jooksul oluliselt laiendanud oma tuumatehnoloogiat. Aastal 2009 avastas ta teise uraani rikastamisjaama ja jätkab ÜRO nõudmistega vastuolus, et peata tegevused, kuni küsimused tema eesmärkide kohta ei ole lahendatud. Tehniliselt nõuab tuumapommi tegemine uraan-235 rikastamist üle 90% – palju rohkem kui 3–5%, mis on vajalik elektrijaamade jaoks, või 20%, mis kasutatakse teadusreageerijates. Iraanil oli mai kuul 6200 kilogrammi madala rikastatud uraani ja 146 kilogrammi 20%-ga rikastatud uraani, nagu ütles Rahvusvaheline Atomaarne Energiakontrolli Amet (IAEA). Ameerika Ühendriikides asuva Teaduse ja Rahvusvahelise Julgeoleku Instituudi (ISIS) hinnangul, mis juhib endine ÜRO relvadeinspektor David Albright, võib see varu rikastada nii, et saavutada piisav kogus relvastatud uraani viie tuumapommiga. Kuid ISIS rõhutab, et 20%-ga rikastatud uraani muutmiseks relvastatudks võtab üle kahe kuu ja alates madala rikastatud uraanist mitu kuud — annades rahvusvahelisele ühiskonnale aega tuvastada ja reageerida. Tuumapommi loomine hõlmab rohkem kui ainult fissiilset materjali. ISIS hinnab, et Iraanil võtab mitu kuud lisaks selleks, et luua testitav seade, ja veel pikem aeg relvastatud külgsuunaga raketi jaoks sobiva relvaga. Kuigi IAEA on kindlaks teinud, et Iraan pole jagunenud ühtegi deklareeritud uraanivaru, on see korduvalt kritiseerinud Teherani täieliku läbipaistvuse puudumist. Iraan väidab, et tema programm on täiesti tsiviilne, samas kui Iisrael süüdistab teda salaja tuumarelva loomises — põhjustades muresid võimaliku sõjalise rünnaku ees. Ameerika Ühendriikide teadusasutuste hinnangul, nagu kinnitas riigiteenistuste juht James Clapper jaanuaris, on Iraan 'hoidmas avatud valikut' tuumarelvi arendada, kuid pole veel otsustanud seda teha.

article_content: Researchers from the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT) have invented a novel structure in a superconducting strip photon detector that enables highly efficient photon detection even with a wide strip. They have successfully developed the world’s first Superconducting Wide-Strip Photon Detector (SWSPD). The strip width of the detector is over 200 times wider than that of conventional Superconducting NanoStrip Photon Detectors (SNSPDs). This innovation addresses longstanding issues of low productivity and polarization dependence in conventional SNSPDs. The new SWSPD is expected to enable early deployment of advanced technologies such as quantum information communication and quantum computing. The work was published in the journal Optica. Photon detection technology is a strategic core technology driving innovation across multiple advanced fields, including quantum information communication, quantum computing, live-cell fluorescent imaging, deep-space optical communication, and laser sensing—all areas experiencing intense global R&D. NICT previously developed SNSPDs with strip widths of 100 nm or less, achieving high performance and demonstrating utility in quantum communication. However, fabricating these devices required advanced nanofabrication techniques, leading to performance variability and low production yields. Additionally, the meandering nanostrip design introduced polarization dependence, limiting practical applications. In this study, NICT introduced the 'High Critical Current Bank' (HCCB) structure, which allows highly efficient photon detection even with a 20-micrometer-wide strip—more than 200 times wider than traditional nanostrips. This marks the first time such high performance has been achieved with a wide-strip design. Unlike SNSPDs, which require long, meandering nanostrips, the SWSPD uses a single, short, straight superconducting strip. It does not require nanofabrication and can be produced using standard, high-throughput photolithography. Because the strip is wider than the incident light spot from optical fibers, polarization dependence is eliminated. Performance evaluations show that the SWSPD achieves a detection efficiency of 78% at the telecommunications wavelength (λ = 1,550 nm)—comparable to the 81% efficiency of SNSPDs—while exhibiting lower timing jitter. This breakthrough enables the fabrication of photon detectors with higher productivity, superior performance, and enhanced reliability compared to nanostrip-based designs, which have long been considered essential in quantum and photonic technologies. The SWSPD is expected to serve as a foundational technology for networked quantum computers under Japan’s JST Moonshot Goal 6. Looking ahead, the NICT team plans to extend the HCCB structure to detect photons efficiently across a broad wavelength range—from visible to mid-infrared—and to expand the photon-receiving area for applications in deep-space optical communication, laser sensing, and live-cell observation.
translated_content: Natsionaalse Info- ja Kommunikatsioonitehnoloogia Instituudi (NICT) teadlased on välja leiutanud uue struktuuri superjuhtiva lindfotodetektoris, mis võimaldab kõrget efektiivsust isegi laiema lindiga. Nad on edukalt arendanud maailma esimese superjuhtiva lai-lindfotodetektori (SWSPD). Detektori lindi laius on üle 200 korda suurem kui tavaliste superjuhtivate nano-lindfotodetektorite (SNSPD) laius. See uus lahendus lahendab traditsiooniliste SNSPD-de pikaajalisi probleeme: madala tootlikkuse ja polariisatsioonisõltuvusega. Uut SWSPD-d oodatakse kasutada tulevikus täpsemates tehnikates, nagu kvantinfotehnoloogias ja kvantarvutites. Töö avaldati ajakirjas Optica. Fotodetektsioonitehnoloogia on strateegiline oluline tehnoloogia, mis toob kaasa innovatsiooni mitmetes täpsetes valdkondades, sealhulgas kvantinfotehnoloogias, kvantarvutites, elavate rakuste fluoresentsiobservatsioonis, sügava ruumi optilises sides ja laserandmete hankimisel — kõik need valdkonnad on praegu globaalselt intensiivselt uuritud ja arendatud. NICT oli varasemalt arendanud SNSPD-sid, mille lindi laius oli 100 nm või vähem, saavutades kõrge jõudluse ja tõestatud kasulikkuse kvantinfotehnoloogia rakendustes. Kuid nende seadmete tootmine nõudis täpset nanotöötlustehnoloogiat, mis põhjustas detektorite jõudluse variatsioone ja takistas tootlikkuse parandamist. Lisaks põhjustasid meander-kujulised nano-lindid polariisatsioonisõltuvuse, mis piiras nende kasutusalasid. Selles töös tutvustas NICT uue struktuuri 'Kõrge kriitiline voolu pangad' (HCCB), mis võimaldab kõrget fotodetektsiooni efektiivsust isegi 20 mikromeetri laiusega lindiga — üle 200 korda laiem kui traditsioonilised nano-lindid. See on esimene kord maailmas, kui selline kõrge jõudlus on saavutatud lai-lind struktuuriga. Erinevalt SNSPD-idest, mis nõuavad pikki meander-kujulisi nano-linte, kasutab SWSPD üht ainset, lühikest, otsest superjuhtivat lindi. Seda ei pea tootma nanotöötlustehnoloogiaga, vaid kasutades tavalist, kõrge tootlikkusega fotolitograafiatega. Kuna lind on laiem kui optilise kõvera poolt sissejuhatatud valguse pilk, eemaldatakse nano-lind-detektoriga seotud polariisatsioonisõltuvus. Jõudluse hindamisel saavutas SWSPD detektsiooni efektiivsuse 78% telekommunikatsiooni lainepikkusel (λ = 1 550 nm) — võrdluses 81% SNSPD-ga — samal ajal näidates paremat ajalise kõikumise väärtust. See läbimurre võimaldab fotodetektorite tootmist, mis on tootlikumad, jõudluselt paremad ja usaldusväärsemad kui nano-lind-põhised disainid, mis on pikka aega peetud oluliseks tehnoloogiaks kvant- ja fototehnoloogiate valdkondades. SWSPD-d oodatakse kasutama erinevates kvantinfotehnoloogiate tehnikates ja see on oluline baastehnoloogia Japäni JST Kuuküüni eesmärgi 6 all edasiarendatavate võrgustatud kvantarvutite jaoks. Tulevikus plaanib NICT-i rühm laiendada HCCB-struktuuri, et tuvastada foteid kõrge efektiivsusega mitte ainult telekommunikatsiooni lainepikkusel, vaid ka laialdasel lainepikkusel — nähtavast keskmise infrapunani — ning laiendada fotovastuvõtu ala, et laiendada rakendusi, nagu sügava ruumi optiline side, laserandmete hankimine ja elavate rakuste observatsioon.

article_content: Washington (CNN) — Hillary Clinton has spent the final moments of the midterm campaign season publicly deflecting questions about her likely presidential run. But behind the scenes, her campaign machine is quietly coming to life. Clinton insiders have begun reaching out to Washington-based Democratic operatives to solicit recommendations for potential staff members, according to Democrats familiar with the conversations. Multiple Democratic sources say several Clinton associates are compiling staffing lists. Michael Whouley and Minyon Moore of the Democratic communications firm Dewey Square Group are among the key figures channeling ideas to Clinton’s inner circle. Whouley, a former adviser to Vice President Al Gore and a Clinton campaign aide, and Moore, a longtime Clinton confidante, are linked to the planning efforts. However, Ginny Terzano, head of communications at Dewey Square Group, denied any formal involvement: 'DSG officials have no role in a potential Clinton campaign.' Operatives at the firm say they are merely 'spitballing ideas,' as one Democratic source described it. Meanwhile, three pro-Hillary superPACs — Ready for Hillary, Priorities USA Action, and Correct the Record — have been actively building support for months, indicating that a Clinton campaign is already underway outside her immediate circle. As the campaign structure forms, Clinton’s team is striving to remain low-profile, wary of the intense scrutiny that follows every move the former secretary of state makes. 'There are no formal talks; no one is being offered jobs,' one source told CNN, dismissing the activity as 'a lot of jockeying' from Democrats eager to join a Clinton campaign. In September, Clinton and her inner circle were frustrated by a Politico leak revealing that John Podesta — former White House chief of staff to President Bill Clinton and now a top aide to President Barack Obama — attended meetings with pro-Clinton superPACs earlier in the summer. Huma Abedin, one of Clinton’s closest aides, has urged allies to quiet speculation about 2016, stressing that Clinton wants to focus attention on the midterm elections and avoid distractions, according to a Democratic source who spoke with Abedin. Clinton and her small team aim to shield her from the political spotlight until she is ready to declare officially — likely by the end of winter, though she prefers to delay as long as possible. 'If there’s not a competitive primary, the general election begins the moment she declares,' said Katie Packer Gage, former deputy campaign manager for Mitt Romney’s 2012 run. 'The real challenge is keeping her fresh in the eyes of the American people.' By this stage in prior cycles, viable presidential contenders had already begun assembling senior staff. In 2012, Matt Rhoades — then executive director of Mitt Romney’s PAC and later his campaign manager — was already in early discussions with future senior aides. Before the 2006 midterms, then-Senator Barack Obama had identified key team members; he launched his exploratory committee in January 2007 and formally entered the race in February. Some operatives caution against reading too much into these early steps. 'Of course preliminary conversations are happening,' said Steve Elmendorf, deputy campaign manager for John Kerry’s 2004 campaign. 'But many people have had those conversations — thought about running, planned to run — and never did.' Among those widely viewed as top prospects for a Clinton campaign, Guy Cecil, current executive director of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, appears to be the leading candidate for campaign manager, based on interviews with more than two dozen Democrats. 'Even if Democrats lose the Senate, people respect the job he’s done,' said one source. Cecil is expected to report to Podesta, who is seen as a stabilizing figure capable of preventing the infighting that marred Clinton’s 2008 campaign. Podesta intends to remain at the White House through the State of the Union address, despite initially committing to one year of service when appointed in December. Robby Mook, who managed Terry McAuliffe’s successful Virginia gubernatorial campaign, has been 'on ice' since early spring, according to two Democrats familiar with the situation. He was told not to make long-term plans but is widely expected to lead the campaign’s operations. Dennis Cheng, who manages fundraising for the Clinton Foundation and previously served as Clinton’s deputy chief of protocol at the State Department, is the frontrunner for finance director, according to multiple Democratic sources. Huma Abedin, Philippe Reines, and Nick Merrill — Clinton’s current spokesperson — are also expected to hold influential roles within or around the campaign.
translated_content: Washington (CNN) — Hillary Clinton on lõppenud mitteseisundite kampanjaajal avalikult kõrvaldamas küsimusi oma tõenäolise presidendikandideerimise kohta. Kuid tagantpoolel käivitub tema kampanjaaparaat vaikseselt. Clintoni sisering on alustanud suhtlemist Washingtoni põhiseaduslike demokraatidega, et saada soovitusi võimalike töötajate kohta, teatasid demokraadid, kes on teadlikud suhetest. Mitmed demokraadid ütlevad, et mitmed Clintoni sidemed koostavad töötajate nimekirju. Michael Whouley ja Minyon Moore demokraatlikust suhtekorraldusfirmast Dewey Square Group on olulised kanalid Clintoni siseringi jaoks ning üks peamisi koostajaid kampanjaühendusele, kui ta kandideerib. Whouley oli asepresident Al Gore'i nõunik ja Clintoni kampanja asemees, samas kui Moore on pika aja jooksul Clintoni usaldusisik. Kuid Dewey Square Groupi suhtekorraldaja Ginny Terzano ütles, et see kirjeldus on 'vale': 'DSG ametnikud ei mängi ühtegi rolli potentsiaalses Clintoni kampanjas.' Firmi ametnikud vaatlevad võimalikke Clintoni töötajaid 'kui nad viskavad ideid', nagu üks demokraatlik allikas sõnastas. Kolme pro-Hillary superPAC-i — Ready for Hillary, Priorities USA Action ja Correct the Record — poolt on toetuse tugevdamine alanud juba kuude kaupa, mis näitab, et Clintoni kampanja on juba käimas väljaspool tema lähedaste ringi. Kui kampanjaaparaat ehitatakse, üritab Clintoni rühm hoida seda vaiksemaks, hoides hoolikalt kaugele valguskõlalistest poliitilistest silmade alt, mis suurendavad iga sammu, mida endine riigisekretär teeb. 'Pole ühtegi vormilist vestlust, keegi ei saa pakkumist,' ütles üks allikas CNN-le, eemaldades kampanjaseadmete märgid kui 'palju jõudlusest' demokraatidelt, kes tahavad Clintoni kampanjas tööd teha. Septembris olid Clinton ja tema sisering rahutud, kui Politico lekkis teave, et John Podesta — endine presidendi Bill Clintoni peaametnik, praegune presidendi Barack Obama kõrge asemees ja isik, keda eeldatakse juhtima Hillary Clintoni kampanja — osales suvel pro-Clinton superPAC-ide kohtumistel. Huma Abedin, üks Clintoni lähedamaid asemees, on palunud mitmetel demokraadidel vaikida 2016. aasta kohta, ütles, et Clinton soovib keskenduda mitteseisundite kampanjale ja vähendada tähelepanu presidendikandideerimisele, vastavalt demokraatlikule allikale, kes rääkis Abediniga. Clinton ja tema väike rühm üritavad hoida teda poliitilise valguskõla eest kuni ta on valmis teha oma kandideerimise ametlikuks — tõenäoliselt talve lõpuni, kuigi ta sooviks seda viivitada nii kaua kui võimalik. 'Kui pole konkurentsi primääris, siis valimised algavad kohe, kui ta deklareerib,' ütles Katie Packer Gage, endine Mitt Romneyi 2012. aasta presidendikampanja asejuht, kes ütles, et Clintoni kampanja väljakutse on sarnane tema praegusele rühmale — 'kuidas nad hoida teda uuesti huvitavaks Ameerika rahvale?' Võimalike demokraatlike või republiklaste presidendikandidaatide kampanjad olid juba selle ajahetkel täielikult ettevalmistuses, kus kõrgemad asemeed olid juba reaalis kandideerimise eelarvestamises. 2012. aastal oli Matt Rhoades, kes oli Mitt Romneyi poliitilise komitee juht ja hiljem tema kampanja juht, juba esimeses vestluses kõigi tulevaste kõrgema juhtkonna liikmetega. Enne 2006. aasta mitteseisundite valimisi oli senaator Barack Obama juba läbi vestlused ja tuvastanud mitmeid kõrgema juhtkonna liikmeid. Tema kampanja läks kiiresti kõrgele pärast valimisi, kuigi ta avas eksploratiivse komitee jaanuaris 2007 ja deklareeris oma kandideerimise veebruaris. Kuid mõned poliitilised ametnikud hoiatavad, et ei tohi liiga palju neid algsete sammude tähendust lugeda. 'Tõesti peaksid algsete vestluste toimuma,' ütles Steve Elmendorf, John Kerry 2004. aasta kampanja asejuht. 'Aga on palju inimesi, kes on need vestlused olnud — mõelnud kandideerimisele, plaaninud kandideerida — ja ei tee.' Nende seas, kes arvatakse olevat potentsiaalses Clintoni kampanjas, tundub, et Guy Cecil, praegune Demokraatliku Senaatori Kampanja Komitee juht, on üks Clintoni kõige tõenäolisemaid valikuid kampanja juhiks, kui rääkida rohkem kui kaheksakümne demokraadiga. 'Isegi kui demokraadid ei säilita Senaadit, kõrbavad inimesed tema tehtud tööd,' ütles üks. Cecili rolli ootetakse Podestaga seotuks, kes on vaikne jõud, kes võib lõpetada paljud sisekonfliktid, mis mõjutasid Clintoni 2008. aasta kampanja. Podesta kavatsus on jääda Valges Majas kuni riigipea kõne, vastavalt kahele allikale, kes teavad tema praegustest plaanidest, kuigi ta esialgselt kohustus ühe aasta teenistusele, kui Obama nimetas ta oma asemeesse West Wingis detsembril. Robby Mook, kes juhtis kampanja, mis tõi Clintoni rahastamise guru Terry McAuliffe'i Virginia valitsuse juhiks, on 'jäänud jäätunud' — kui üks demokraat ütles — alates kevadest, vastavalt kahele demokraadile, kes teavad vestlusest. Talle ütleti mitte teha pikemaajalisi planeerimisi, kes on lähedal Clintonile, ja ta on laialdaselt oodatud mängima suurt rolli kampanja juhtimisel. Dennis Cheng, kes juhib rahastamist Clintoni基金会 ja teenis Hillary Clintoni asepeaministrina riigisekretäri kabinetis, on eeskujuks rahastamise juhiks, vastavalt mitmetele demokraadile. Huma Abedin, Philippe Reines ja Nick Merrill — Clintoni praegune pressiesindaja — oodatakse, et nad mängivad olulisi rolle kampanjas või selle ümber.

article_content: Saturday’s audition for 'America's Next Top Model' at the Park Central Hotel in Manhattan descended into chaos, leading to three arrests and six injuries, two of which required hospitalization, according to local police. Authorities have not determined what triggered the unrest, though those detained face charges of disorderly conduct and inciting a riot. The event was abruptly canceled following the disturbance. The hotel’s management has not yet responded to media inquiries. The reality competition, led by supermodel Tyra Banks and broadcast on the CW network, is currently in its 12th season.

Asutused ei tea, mis põhjustas paanika, kuid need, kes on arreteeritud, on süüdistatud rikkumises ja häirivates tegudes. Sündmus lõpetati kohe pärast häiret. article_content: London (CNN) — Passengers arriving at London’s Heathrow Airport faced lengthy delays at passport control this week, with waits of up to three hours reported for non-EU travelers on Thursday night. Similar congestion occurred Friday night, according to UK media. The British Airports Authority (BAA), which operates Heathrow, condemned the delays as ‘unacceptable’ but emphasized it does not manage immigration — a responsibility of the UK Home Office. 'There is no trade-off between strong border security and a positive passenger experience,' said a BAA spokesperson. 'The Home Office must act urgently.' By Saturday morning, queues still stretched for about an hour, though conditions improved by midday. UK Border Force head Brian Moore defended operations, stating that most travelers pass through efficiently and that delays stem from unpredictable factors such as late or early flights causing passenger bunching. 'We deploy staff flexibly to match demand,' he said. The agency is now closely monitoring flight arrivals and passenger flows over the weekend. The situation has sparked growing alarm as London prepares to host the 2012 Olympic Games, expecting thousands of additional visitors in July and August. Traveler Leo Lourdes described being stuck in 'massive, massive queues' at Terminal 5 twice this month — once returning from Germany and again from Costa Rica. 'I saw only a few desks manned after three hours,' he said. 'Many looked disappointed — especially with Olympic banners everywhere.' Another passenger, Chris Windebank, recounted being shouted at by staff to 'get to the end of the queue' and receiving no explanation upon arrival. 'I felt like a commodity, not a customer,' he said. His experience contrasted sharply with the smooth process he encountered in Berlin. 'This will hurt British business unless fixed,' he warned. Former Downing Street communications chief Alastair Campbell tweeted that if this is how Heathrow handles an ordinary Thursday, Olympic athletes might reconsider their travel plans. He noted only three or four officers were processing EU arrivals and just three for non-EU travelers. Meanwhile, Keith Vaz, chair of the Home Affairs Committee, confirmed that Immigration Minister Damian Green had been summoned to explain the breakdown. Despite criticism, Moore insisted the Border Force is fully prepared for Olympic-era crowds. An additional 40,000 passengers are expected on August 13 — the day after the Games end — prompting BAA to build a dedicated terminal for departing athletes and officials.
translated_content: London (CNN) — Lõuna-Londoni lennujaama Heathrow’i saabuvad reisijad kogevad selle nädala jooksul pikki ooteaegu pasjukontrollil, kus mitte-EÜ reisijatel oli neljapäeval õhtul kuni kolm tundi oodata. Sarnane kongestatsioon esines ka reede õhtul, järgides Briti meedia teavet. Briti Lennujaamade Autoriteet (BAA), mis juhib Heathrow’i, nimetas viimaseid viivitusi 'tundmatuteks', kuid rõhutas, et see ei ole tema vastutus — see on Suurbritannia Siseministeeriumi vastutus. 'Tugev piirivalve ja positiivne reisija kogemus ei ole vastandlikud,' ütles BAA esindaja. 'Siseministeerium peab tegema kiiresti.' Laupäeva hommikul olid järjestikused järjed veel umbes tunni pikkuseks, kuid tingimused paranesid keskpäevaks. Suurbritannia Piirivalve juht Brian Moore kaitseb operatsioone, öeldes, et suur osa reisijatest läbib kontrolli kiiresti ja et viivitused põhjustatakse eelarvamata teguritega, nagu hilised või varased lendud, mis põhjustavad reisijate kogunemist. 'Me kohaldatakse töötajaid paindlikult, et vastata nõudlusele,' ütles ta. Asutus jälgib täna õhtuni lendude saabumist ja reisijate liikumist. Olukord on põhjustanud kasvava muret, kuna London valmistub 2012. aasta olümpiamängude korraldamiseks ja ootab juulis ja augustis tuhandeid lisareisijaid. Reisija Leo Lourdes kirjeldas, kuidas ta sai kinni 'massiivsetes, massiivsetes järjedes' Terminal 5-is kaks korda selle kuu jooksul — üks kord Saksamaalt ja teine Costa Ricast naastes. 'Kolme tunni pärast nägin ainult mõnda vahetust töötamas,' ütles ta. 'Paljud näisid pettunud — eriti olümpia plakatide kõrval.' Teine reisija, Chris Windebank, rääkis, kuidas ta sai lennujaama turvalisuse poolt hüüduga 'mine järje lõppu' ja ei saanud üldse selgitust. 'Ma tundsin end kogu kommodina, mitte lennujaama tasuvana reisijana,' ütles ta. Tema kogemus oli vastandlik Saksamaal Berliinis kogutulemusega. 'See kahjustab Briti äri, kui seda ei parandata,' hoiatas ta. Endine Downing Streeti kommunikatsiooni juht Alastair Campbell postitas neljapäeval Twitteris: 'Kui see on, kuidas Heathrow T5 käsitseb tavalist neljapäeva, siis olümpialauad peaksid mõtlemama, kas nad tulevad.' Ta märkis, et ainult kolm või neli ametnikku töötasid EÜ reisijate ja kolm mitte-EÜ reisijate kontrollimisel. Samal ajal kinnitas kodanikuasjade komitee esimees Keith Vaz, et siseminister Damian Green on kutsutud seletama, mis toimub. Kriitika hoolimata, kehtestas Moore, et piirivalve on täielikult valmis olümpiaajalise nõudluse jaoks. 13. augustil, mängude lõppemise järgsel päeval, oodatakse 40 000 lisareisijat — mille tõttu BAA ehitab eraldi terminali lahkuvateks sportlasteks ja ametnikuks.

article_content: ZURICH, Switzerland — Martina Hingis has shocked the tennis world by disclosing that she tested positive for cocaine following her third-round exit at Wimbledon in 2007. A five-time Grand Slam champion and former world number one who spent 209 weeks atop the rankings, Hingis, 27, announced her second retirement from professional tennis. She firmly denied ever using performance-enhancing drugs, calling the allegation 'horrendous' and 'monstrous.' 'I've never taken drugs — I am 100 percent innocent,' said Hingis, who was defeated 6-4, 6-2 by Laura Granville at the All England Club. In an emotional statement, she declared, 'My weapon on the court has always been one thing: the game itself — the ingenuity, the love of tennis. That is my only performance enhancer.' Hingis, who returned to the tour after a prior retirement in 2006 and won three WTA titles that year, finished the season ranked seventh. She entered 2007 ranked 19th. Her final match was a second-round loss to China’s Peng Shuai on September 19 in Beijing. Rumors of her retirement circulated ahead of her press conference in Zurich. Hingis confirmed she has hired an attorney to defend her reputation. However, she chose retirement to avoid being drawn into a potentially years-long legal battle. 'Cases like this can drag on for years, especially with repeated appeals,' she explained. 'I have no desire to spend the next several years fighting doping officials.' The WTA Tour has not received official notification of the positive test. 'As a result, we are not in a position to comment,' said CEO Larry Scott. 'But we must emphasize: all players are presumed innocent until proven otherwise.' He added, 'Martina Hingis is a tremendous champion and a global fan favorite. Her recent comeback proved she remains capable of competing at the highest level.'

Tema viimane tulek tõestas, et ta on veel võimeline kõrgeimat tasemel mängima.'

article_content: Pakistan’s 2023 Cricket World Cup campaign ended on a low note in Kolkata, where they were defeated by England by 93 runs in their final group-stage match. After winning only four of nine games, they finished fifth — their lowest ranking in a World Cup since 2007. Captain Babar Azam openly admitted the team’s shortcomings across batting, bowling, and fielding. 'We made mistakes everywhere,' he said. 'It’s tough to accept, but we have to own it.' Their failure to reach the semi-finals for the third consecutive World Cup underscored a broader decline in performance. A major concern highlighted by Babar was the lack of impact from his spinners, Mohammed Nawaz and Shadab Khan, during the crucial middle overs. 'We leaked too many runs at the end, and our spinners didn’t pick up wickets when we needed them most — that cost us dearly.' Despite the crushing exit, Babar expressed a clear intent to remain captain during the rebuilding phase. 'We’ll sit down, take stock of everything, keep what worked, fix what didn’t — and build something better. I want to be part of that journey.'

article_content: Meet the Afropolitans: a new generation of Africans and people of African descent who embrace a global identity while maintaining deep ties to the continent. Coined in 2005 by Nigerian-Ghanaian writer Taiye Selasi, the term describes multilingual, internationally rooted individuals who identify as 'Africans of the world' — not citizens of a single nation, but global citizens with African heritage. Today, 'Afropolitan' is no longer confined to New York hipsters or European capitals. It resonates in Africa’s own vibrant megacities like Lagos, Nairobi, and Johannesburg. But who exactly are Afropolitans? Brendah Nyakudya, editor of Afropolitan magazine in South Africa and a Zimbabwean who has lived in London, embodies the ideal: 'I have African roots, but I’ve been raised by the world — and that’s shaped my identity.' Her magazine targets intelligent, politically conscious urban professionals in their 30s — many of whom she considers Afropolitans. According to Nyakudya, an Afropolitan is someone with African roots, raised globally, yet committed to contributing meaningfully to Africa’s future — whether through philanthropy, policy, or cultural innovation. Importantly, she believes the label isn’t limited by birthplace: 'If you’re on the continent and you love it, you’re an Afropolitan.' Yet not everyone agrees. Tolu Ogunlesi, a Nigerian journalist based in Lagos, calls the term 'problematic.' He argues it’s often misapplied to diasporic elites while ignoring urban Africans living in places like Lagos and Nairobi who share the same global outlook. 'It should mean an African in an urban setting with a cosmopolitan mindset — not just someone living abroad,' he says. Minna Salami, a Finnish-Nigerian blogger known as Msafropolitan, agrees. Having lived across four continents, she rejects the notion that Afropolitanism is solely a diaspora phenomenon. 'Africa has always had cosmopolitan cities,' she notes. 'Lagos, Cape Town, Dakar — they’re hubs of art, music, and creativity shaped by global influences.' For Salami, Afropolitanism is a politically charged movement: it challenges outdated narratives of Africa as a 'dark, failing continent' by showcasing its vibrant, modern culture through art, fashion, and digital platforms. Social media, she emphasizes, has been instrumental in connecting African creatives worldwide. Ogunlesi acknowledges this too: while ordinary Nigerians don’t call themselves Afropolitans, they’re just as connected to global pop culture thanks to the internet and satellite TV. African music — from Femi Kuti to Spoeke Mathambo — and style — inspired by magazines like Arise — travel fast, shaping a shared aesthetic. But Nyakudya insists: being an Afropolitan isn’t about having the right playlist or wardrobe. It’s about action. 'If you call yourself an Afropolitan, you must be doing something to improve Africa — lobbying for reform, supporting communities, or creating change. Otherwise, it’s just a label.'
translated_content: Tutvustame afropoliite: uus põlvkond aafriklasi ja aafriklaste päritolu inimesi, kes omavad globaalset identiteeti ja säilitavad sügavaid sidemeid kontinendiga. Termin 'afropoliit' esines esmakordselt 2005. aastal nigerialase/ghaanalase kirjaniku Taiye Selasi artiklis. See kirjeldab multilinguaalseid, rahvusvaheliselt kasvatatud isikuid, kes identifitseerivad end kui 'Aafrika maailma' — mitte ühe riigi kodanikke, vaid globaalseid kodanikke aafrika päritoluga. Täna ei piirdu termin 'afropoliit' New Yorgi hipstereid ega Euroopa pealinnasid. See kõlab Aafrika omades elavates metropoolides nagu Lagos, Nairobi ja Johannesburg. Kuid kes need afropoliidid tegelikult on? Brendah Nyakudya, Aafrika magazine toimetaja Lõuna-Aafrikas ja Zimbabwes sündinud inimene, kes on elanud Londonis, on selle idee esindaja: 'Mul on Aafrika juured, kuid ma olen maailma poolt kasvatatud — ja see on moodustanud minu identiteedi.' Tema ajakiri suunatakse intelligentsatele, poliitiliselt teadlikule linnalisele professionaalidele 30-aastaste hulka — paljud neist ta peab afropoliitideks. Nyakudya sõnul on afropoliit isik, kes on Aafrika juurtega, globaalselt kasvatatud, kuid kohustunud mõjutama Aafrika tulevikku — kas filantroopiliselt, poliitiliselt või kultuuriliselt. Ta usub samuti, et nimetus ei ole seotud sünnikohtaga: 'Kui sa oled kontinendil ja armastad seda, siis sa oled afropoliit.' Kuid mitte kõik nõustuvad. Tolu Ogunlesi, nigerialane ajakirjanik, kes elab Lagosis, nimetab terminit 'probleemiliseks'. Ta väidab, et seda kasutatakse sageli diaspoora eliidi suhtes, unustades linnalisi aafriklasi, kes elavad nagu Lagos ja Nairobi ja jagavad sama globaalset vaatenurka. 'See peaks tähendama Aafrika inimest linnas, kosmopoliitliku hoiakuga — mitte ainult inimest väljaspool,' ütleb ta. Minna Salami, soome-nigerialane blogija, keda tuntakse kui Msafropolitan, nõustub. Ta on elanud neli kontinenti ja tagasi lükkab mõiste, et afropoliitism on ainult diaspoora nähtus. 'Aafrikal on alati olnud kosmopoliitlikke linnasid,' ta märkib. 'Lagos, Kaaplinn, Dakar — need on kunsti, muusika ja globaalsete mõjudega täidetud keskused.' Salami jaoks on afropoliitism poliitiliselt tähtis liikumine: see vajab vananenud narratiive Aafrikast kui 'tume, ebaõnnestunud kontinendist', et esitada selle elavat, tänapäevast kultuuri kunsti, moe ja digitaalsete platvormide kaudu. Sotsiaalmeedia, ta rõhutab, on olnud oluline, et ühendada Aafrika loovtöötajaid maailmas. Ogunlesi tunnistab seda ka: kuigi tavalised nigerialased ei nimeta end afropoliitideks, on nad samuti ühendatud globaalse popkultuuriga interneti ja satelliittelevisiooni tõttu. Aafrika muusika — Femi Kutist Spoeke Mathamboni — ja stiil — Arise ajakirja inspiratsiooniga — levivad kiiresti ja moodustavad ühise estetika. Aga Nyakudya jahhatab: olla afropoliit ei tähenda ainult õiget playlisti või riietust. See tähendab tegevust. 'Kui sa nimetad end afropoliidiks, pead tegema midagi Aafrika parandamiseks — lobbydama reforme, toetama kogukondi või looma muutust. Muul juhul on see lihtsalt sõna.'

article_content: On Tuesday, U.S. Army General Lloyd J. Austin III returned home carrying the American command flag from Baghdad — a symbolic gesture marking the official end of America’s nearly nine-year military presence in Iraq. The flag, ceremonially folded in Iraq just days earlier, was handed over at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland, where President Obama and Vice President Biden stood alongside top military officials. Though neither president spoke, General Martin Dempsey, chair of the Joint Chiefs, called it a moment to honor both those who came home and those who didn’t. Over 4,500 American service members lost their lives; more than 30,000 were injured. Estimates suggest over 100,000 Iraqi civilians died during the conflict. The war began in 2003 under the premise that Saddam Hussein possessed weapons of mass destruction — claims later disproven, as Iraq had already dismantled such programs years before. What followed was not peace, but chaos: an insurgency fueled by remnants of Hussein’s regime, al-Qaeda affiliates, and Iranian-backed militias. Sectarian bloodshed exploded after the 2006 bombing of a revered Shiite mosque, leaving the streets of Baghdad and other cities filled with corpses for months. A 2007 surge of 30,000 additional U.S. troops helped calm the violence by aligning with former enemies — Sunni tribes turned against extremists. Iraq held elections, executed Hussein, and drafted a constitution — but today, just days after the last U.S. convoy departed, the country teeters again. Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki’s Shiite-led government accuses its main Sunni rival of orchestrating attacks, prompting the opposition to boycott parliament and accuse al-Maliki of consolidating autocratic control. General Austin praised troops for removing a tyrant and giving Iraqis a chance at self-rule. Yet, as the U.S. exits, the future of that democracy remains uncertain.

article_content: Scotland's central defensive duo have vowed they are ready to do what Germany couldn't: stop Poland's prolific goal machine led by the formidable Robert Lewandowski. The Bayern Munich striker assisted Sebastian Mila's second goal in Poland's shocking 2-0 victory over the world champions in Warsaw on Saturday night — Germany's first qualifying defeat since October 2007. The free-scoring Poles now top Group D on goal difference from Ireland, having won both games with nine goals scored and none conceded. Scotland must perform better than Germany did in containing Poland’s Robert Lewandowski. Wigan midfielder Shaun Maloney scored the decisive goal in Scotland’s 1-0 win over Georgia. But Scotland center-back Russell Martin insists Lewandowski and his teammates hold no fear. His defensive partner, Grant Hanley, is equally confident that Gordon Strachan’s side can handle the challenge in Warsaw on Tuesday. After Scotland’s 1-0 win over Georgia, Martin said: 'Robert Lewandowski is one of the best in the world in his position — but it’s up to us to neutralize his threat. I’ve competed week in week out against players of his caliber in the Premier League, so I know what to expect. Luis Suárez was the toughest — he’s just a brilliant player. With Scotland, we kept a clean sheet against Croatia and Mario Mandžukić. I’ve also played against Christian Benteke of Belgium. Germany have strong attackers too.' Scotland defender Russell Martin and Steven Naismith celebrated Maloney’s winner. Scotland will also need to contain substitute Sebastian Mila, who scored Poland’s second goal in Warsaw. 'Grant Hanley and I are both desperate to return to the Premier League as soon as possible, and tests like these against Poland and Lewandowski are exactly the kind you need to pass. We need to prove we’re still ready — that we can compete at that level. I haven’t faced Lewandowski as often as other strikers because he plays in Germany, but our staff will make sure we study him thoroughly before the match. We’ll be fully prepared. There will be no excuses. 'But Lewandowski isn’t Poland’s only threat — stopping him will be a team effort. We’ll be ready. And we go there confident after keeping a clean sheet against Georgia.' Blackburn captain Grant Hanley also welcomed the challenge in Warsaw after shutting out Georgia at Ibrox. The 22-year-old took confidence from Scotland’s 1-0 friendly win in Poland in March — a victory sealed by a Scott Brown goal, although neither he nor Lewandowski played that night. 'We know Poland have a big name in their team, but we’re going there with a clear game plan,' said Hanley. 'Hopefully, we’ll get something out of the game. Playing against Robert Lewandowski will be difficult, but we’re confident we can handle it. We’ll give them the respect they deserve — but we’ve coped with Mario Mandžukić before. It’s going to be a test, though.' 'We’d be happy if David Marshall doesn’t have a save to make in Poland — like against Georgia — but we know it’ll be a different game out there. Scotland defeated Poland 1-0 in a friendly in March thanks to a goal from Celtic captain Scott Brown.' 'I wouldn’t say whether a draw would be a good result over there, but with the confidence we have now, we have to go in aiming for another performance like that one — and then who knows what might happen? I wasn’t involved in the March win, but that result has given the squad belief. We have players who can make an impact, and with a bit of luck, I don’t think we’ll be far off. There’s no reason to fear them — we’re playing with no fear.'

'Aga Lewandowski ei ole ainus Poola oht – ja on vaja koostööd, et teda peatada. Aga me oleme valmis. Ja me läheme sinna kindlusega pärast Gruusia vastu puhta kaitse saamist.' 'Me teame, et Poolal on suur nimi oma meeskonnas, aga me läheme sinna mänguplaaniga,' ütles 22-aastane. 'Ja, loodetavasti, saame midagi välja. 'Muidugi, mängida Robert Lewandowskiga on raske, aga me oleme kindlad, et saame sellest toime. Me anname neile austust, mida nad teenivad, aga me peame meeles, et me hakkasime toime Mario Mandžukići. See on test, aga…' 'Me oleksime õnnelikud, kui David Marshall ei peaks Poolas ühtegi hoidmast tegema (nagu Gruusia vastu), aga me teame, et see on erinev mäng seal. Skotia võitis Poola 1:0 sõprusmängus märtsis Scott Browni väravaga.' 'Ma ei soovi öelda, kas viik oleks hea tulemus seal, aga meie kindlusega peame minema sinna, et toota veel ükskord sellist esinemist, ja siis keda teab, mis juhtub? Ma ei olnud seotud, kui me võitsime Poolas märtsis, aga see tulemus on andnud meeskonnale usku. Meil on mängijaid, kes saavad mõjutada, ja veidi õnne, ma ei usu, et me olemme kaugel. Pole põhjuseid neid kartma, sest me mängime ilma kartuseta.'

article_content: Marc Marquez is one step away from making history as the youngest rider ever to win the MotoGP championship after securing pole position for the season finale in Valencia. The 20-year-old Spaniard set a new lap record of 1:30.237 on Saturday, outpacing his closest rival and defending champion, Jorge Lorenzo, by 0.340 seconds. Joining him on the front row is his Honda teammate, Dani Pedrosa, who narrowly avoided a crash during his final qualifying lap. Despite the scare, Pedrosa remained optimistic. 'It was a little reminder that I need to be 100% focused tomorrow,' Pedrosa said. 'Thankfully, I feel strong, have good rhythm, and now I just need to focus on my own race.' Marquez needs only a fourth-place finish on Sunday to seal an extraordinary debut season — becoming the first rookie to claim the premier class title since American legend Kenny Roberts did so in 1978. Italy’s Valentino Rossi qualified fourth aboard his Yamaha, while Britain’s Cal Crutchlow took fifth. His Monster Yamaha Tech 3 teammate, Bradley Smith, completed the second row of the grid.

Esimene rida on ta ja tema Honda koostööline Dani Pedrosa, kes hoidis viimasel kvalifikatsiooniringil peaaegu kinni. Kuigi see oli kartust tekitav moment, jäi Pedrosa optimismiks. 'See oli väike meeldetuletus, et mul on vaja homseks olla 100% keskendunud,' ütles Pedrosa. 'Ilus, et tunnen end hästi, mul on hea tempokäik ja nüüd pean ainult keskenduma oma jooksule.' Marquezile piisab homse võistlusel neljanda koha saamisest, et kinnitada suurepärast debüütsezonit ja saada esimeseks noorkõrvaltajaks, kes on võitnud esimese klassi tiitli pärast Ameerika legendaarse Kenny Robertsi, kes seda tegi 1978. aastal. Itaalia Valentino Rossi kvalifitseerus neljandaks oma Yamahaga, briti Cal Crutchlow sai viienda koha ja tema Monster Yamaha Tech 3 koostööline Bradley Smith täidab teise rea.

article_content: Millard Fuller, co-founder of Habitat for Humanity International, has died at age 74, officials announced Tuesday. He passed away early Tuesday morning while en route to a hospital after a brief illness, according to the Fuller Center for Housing in Americus, Georgia — the organization he led until his death. Fuller, originally from Alabama, rose from modest beginnings to become a self-made millionaire through a successful marketing business. But as his wealth grew, his health, relationships, and personal values deteriorated. A spiritual awakening led him to reconcile with his wife, Linda, sell all their possessions, and dedicate their lives to serving the poor. Together, they discovered Koinonia Farm, a Christian intentional community in rural Georgia, where they partnered with founder Clarence Jordan to launch a pioneering housing ministry. Homes were built with volunteer labor, sold at no profit, and financed through a revolving fund — allowing each completed home to help finance the next. In 1973, the Fullers tested this model in Zaire (now the Democratic Republic of the Congo), where it succeeded. Upon returning to the U.S. in 1976, they formally established Habitat for Humanity International. The organization has since provided shelter for more than 1.5 million people across 3,000 communities worldwide. Fuller received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 1996, with President Clinton calling Habitat 'the most successful continuous community service project in U.S. history.' Former President Jimmy Carter, a close friend and fellow Georgian, called Fuller 'one of the most extraordinary people I have ever known,' praising his use of entrepreneurial talent to uplift the global poor. In 2005, Fuller left Habitat for Humanity following disagreements with its board. While allegations of inappropriate conduct toward a former employee were raised, no conclusive evidence was found. The board cited his disruptive public statements as the reason for his departure. Fuller countered that the board sought to replace him with financially focused leaders who lacked spiritual conviction. After leaving, Fuller founded the Fuller Center for Housing, a faith-driven, nonprofit ministry rooted in the same principles as Habitat but with a stronger emphasis on evangelical Christian witness. The center continues its mission today, helping families secure safe, affordable housing. Funeral services are scheduled for Wednesday. Fuller will be laid to rest at Koinonia Farm, the place where his journey of service began.
translated_content: Millard Fuller, Habitat for Humanity Internationali koosalustaja, on surnud 74-aastasena, teatasid ametnikud teisipäeval. Ta suri teisipäeva hommikul, kui ta oli teel haiglasse pärast lühikest haigust, teatas Fuller Center for Housing Americusest, Georgia — organisatsioon, mida ta juhtis kuni oma surmani. Fuller, kes oli algselt Alabamast, tõusis modeste algusest iseäraisaatlikuks miljonäriks edukate turundusfirmade kaudu. Kuid tema varanduse kasvades halvenes tema tervis, suhted ja isiklikud väärtused. Vaimne äratuse tulemusel ta kogus oma naise Lindaga kokku, müüs kõik oma vara ja pühendus elu vaeseteenindamisele. Ühiselt leidsid nad Koinonia Farmi, kristlikku tarklikku ühiskonda linnasoolises Georgias, kus nad koostöös alustaja Clarence Jordaniga käivitasid innovatiivse eluasemeministri. Majad ehitati voluntaaride jõupingutustega, müüdi ilma kasumita ja rahastati ringliku rahaallika kaudu — nii et iga valmis majaga võidi rahastada järgmist. 1973. aastal proovisid Fulleri paar seda mudelit Zaïres (tänapäeval Kongo Demokraatlik Vabariik), kus see õnnestus. Pärast USA-sse naasmist 1976. aastal nad ametlikult asutasid Habitat for Humanity Internationali. Organisatsioon on pakkunud laagrit üle 1,5 miljoni inimese 3000 ühiskonna üle maailma. Fuller sai 1996. aastal presidendi Vabaduse medali, milles president Clinton nimetas Habitatit 'Ameerika Ühendriikide ajaloo kõige eduks saanud pidevaks ühiskondliku teenistuse projekti'. Eelmine president Jimmy Carter, lähedane sõber ja sama Georgia elanik, nimetas Fulleri 'üheks kõige väga erilise inimeseks, mida ma olen kunagi tuntud', tähelepanudes tema ettevõtlikkuse kasutamist globaalse vaesuse vähendamiseks. 2005. aastal lahkus Fuller Habitat for Humanityst pärast erimeelsusi nõukoguga. Kuigi esitati süüdistused ebakohase käitumise kohta endise töötaja suhtes, ei leitud tõenditega tõendatud tõttu. Nõukogu viitas tema häirivale avalikule kõnelejale põhjuseks tema lahkumiseks. Fuller vastas, et nõukogu soovis asendada teda rahaliste fookusega juhtidega, kes puudutasid vaimset uskumust. Pärast lahkumist asutas Fuller Fuller Center for Housingi, vaimselt orienteeritud mitteõigusliku ministri, mis põhines samadel põhimõtetel nagu Habitat, kuid rõhutas tugevamalt evangeelset kristlikku tõendust. Keskus jätkab oma missiooni täna, aitades pereliikmetel tagada ohutud ja odavad eluasemed. Surnuaia teenistused on plaanitud keskpäevaks. Fuller maetatakse Koinonia Farmile, kus tema teenimise teekond algas.

article_content: By Abigail Frymann. PUBLISHED: 11:01 EST, 16 November 2013. | UPDATED: 12:26 EST, 16 November 2013. Young lion cubs, a brother and sister, playfully wrestle as their father rests nearby. When one picks up a stick, the other becomes possessive, sparking a brief tug-of-war. Their father, however, remains tolerant — even joining in, allowing the six-month-old cubs to climb all over him. Award-winning wildlife photographer Mark Smith captured the scene in the late afternoon sun in the Savuti area of Chobe National Park, Botswana. After a long daytime nap, the cubs grew restless, offering Smith a rare glimpse into their social development. Smith, from London, said: 'The brother and sister wrestle and squabble much like children, while their parents rest ahead of nightfall. There are also images of the cubs wrestling with their father.' 'When cubs are young, male lions typically stay at a distance from the pride. But as they grow older, they become fascinated by their fathers, often approaching to play.' One cub clambers over its father’s face. 'Get your paw out of my eye!' While Dad helps the cubs practice fighting skills, one day he and his coalition will be replaced by younger males. 'When cubs are small, males generally remain distant from the pride, but older cubs are fascinated by their fathers and often try to play. This often results in the male telling the cub to go away — or, if the lion is in a good mood, he’ll play and teach fighting techniques in the process.' 'Here, the cubs were simply with Dad, who was in a very tolerant mood.' The family belongs to an unusual pride of 35 lions, led by a coalition of five males. According to Smith, once a coalition takes over a pride, it typically holds power for about two years — though larger coalitions of four to six lions may last up to four. Smith added: 'Lions are intensely social cats, unlike many other feline species that are solitary. This sociability is largely an adaptation for cooperative hunting.' 'That’s why lions are the cats you’re most likely to see socializing and playing in large groups.' 'Like many animals, lion cubs learn through play — developing coordination, muscle control, and skills such as paw-eye coordination.' 'Essentially, this play prepares them for hunting.' 'There were plenty of sticks around, but once one was chosen, both cubs wanted it. It’s likely the stick resembled prey or a toy — and wrestling over it is a feline way of establishing social boundaries.'

article_content: Tensions flared in the Australia-India Test match as Australia moved closer to a 4-0 series sweep, overshadowed by controversy over sledging and crowd behavior. Virat Kohli, playing in his eighth Test, scored his maiden Test century — 116 runs — under intense pressure, both physical and psychological. After narrowly avoiding being run out on 99, the 23-year-old accused Australian bowler Ben Hilfenhaus of unsolicited verbal abuse. 'He wasn’t even bowling,' Kohli told reporters. 'He just said something I can’t repeat here. I told him, ‘Why? You had nothing to do with it.’' Kohli described the atmosphere in Adelaide as toxic, citing constant sledging from the Australian team and abusive chants from a record crowd of 35,081 — many of whom, he said, 'got drunk and abuse players.' 'We’re here to play cricket, not be abused,' he said. 'If fans want to enjoy the game, they should do that — not shout insults and walk away unchallenged.' Earlier in the match, tensions were ignited when India’s Gautam Gambhir questioned Siddle’s skill, suggesting he relied on favorable pitches. Siddle responded emphatically, taking 5-49 and dismissing Gambhir for 34, along with Sachin Tendulkar for 25. Hilfenhaus added 3-62, while Australia posted a commanding 604-7 declared, thanks to double centuries from Michael Clarke and Ricky Ponting. India’s lower order briefly fought back, with Kohli and Wriddhiman Saha putting on 114 for the sixth wicket. But spinner Ravichandran Ashwin and veteran Zaheer Khan then dismantled Australia’s top order, leaving the hosts at 50-3 in their second innings — still trailing by 382 runs. Meanwhile, in Abu Dhabi, Pakistan restricted England to 207-5 in reply to their 257. Off-spinner Saeed Ajmal, who took 7-55 in the first Test, claimed three more wickets in the final half-hour, including Alastair Cook (94). Stuart Broad finished with four wickets, and James Anderson took two quick ones to halt England’s momentum. The three-match series is being held in the UAE as Pakistan remains unable to host international cricket due to security concerns.

article_content: A mother has been arrested after her 15-month-old son died from heat exposure inside a parked SUV in Corpus Christi, Texas. Concepcion Rodriguez, 26, forgot her toddler, Benny Jr., in the back seat after unloading six other children from the vehicle on Wednesday afternoon. Temperatures outside reached 100°F, causing the interior of the black SUV to soar to 140°F. Rodriguez only realized her mistake when her husband returned home three hours later and asked about the child. Emergency responders arrived but were unable to revive Benny. She has since been charged with injury to a child, a second-degree felony punishable by up to 20 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. Family and neighbors expressed profound sorrow. Cornelio Reyna, a family friend, described Benny as 'a very happy kid who was always playing with mommy and daddy.' Neighbors Robert Mendoza and Melinda Moore shared their heartbreak, noting the tragedy felt especially close given their own children and grandchildren. Police emphasized that this is part of a troubling pattern: according to Golden Gate Weather Services, 15 children have died in hot cars across the U.S. this year, including four in Texas. Amber Rollins of Kids and Cars stressed, 'It can happen to anybody.' Authorities urge caregivers to never leave children unattended in vehicles, keep cars locked, and use reminders—such as placing a purse, phone, or shoe next to the child—to prevent such tragedies.

article_content: Katie Piper, the acid attack survivor and television presenter, has announced her engagement to her boyfriend, James, a carpenter. She shared the joyful news on Twitter, revealing that he proposed last night — getting down on one knee in a heartfelt moment. In a heartfelt Instagram post the night before, Katie shared photos of a romantic home dinner: baked cod with capers, prepared by James, served on their kitchen table in formal attire. 'Pretending we are going out for dinner!' she wrote, adding, 'Parents night in/out — no babysitter needed.' The couple, who welcomed their daughter Belle Elizabeth in March 2014, met through a mutual friend. Their first date was nerve-wracking, Katie recalls, but James put her at ease by treating her normally — never mentioning her scars. 'He didn’t stare. So I didn’t either,' she said. Katie was just 24 when, in 2008, her ex-boyfriend Danny Lynch orchestrated a brutal attack: she was raped, beaten, and then had industrial-strength sulfuric acid thrown in her face by a hired assailant, Stefan Sylvestre. The assault left her with devastating injuries and triggered over 100 reconstructive surgeries. Despite the trauma, Katie transformed her pain into purpose. She founded the Katie Piper Foundation to support burn survivors, appeared in documentaries, authored an autobiography, and continues to work as a TV presenter. In October 2014, she received an honorary degree from Anglia Ruskin University. Lynch and Sylvestre were both sentenced to life in prison — Lynch will serve a minimum of 12 years. Katie has spoken candidly about her journey: 'He almost succeeded in extinguishing the last of the old Katie. Almost.' Today, she says, love has helped her reclaim her life.

article_content: On September 6, 2013, nearly 10,000 people gathered at the Maverik Center in Draper, Utah, to honor Sergeant Derek Johnson — a beloved police officer, devoted husband, and loving father — who was fatally shot in the line of duty on September 1. His 6-year-old son, Ben, stood beside his mother, Shante, holding a flag as officers carried Johnson’s flag-draped casket into the packed arena. The community’s overwhelming response reflected deep respect for a man known for his kindness, humor, and tireless dedication to public safety. The suspect, Timothy 'Troy' Walker, shot Johnson before turning the gun on his long-term partner, Traci Vaillancourt, and then himself. Both are currently in critical condition at Intermountain Medical Center, under police supervision as investigators work to piece together what happened. Vaillancourt, once a promising high school model, struggled after being diagnosed with Hereditary Angioedema — a rare illness causing extreme swelling and chronic pain. After suffering four strokes before turning 30, she became dependent on prescription pain medication, eventually losing her home and distancing herself from loved ones. Her sister, Victoria King, described how Walker filled a void in her life, offering affection she desperately needed — while also introducing her to drugs and firearms. 'He was bad news from the start,' King said. 'I tried to save her. But she chose him.' Walker, who had a record of petty theft but no history of violence, allegedly targeted Johnson after noticing his patrol car approach their parked Volvo. Authorities believe both individuals were under the influence at the time. Despite being mortally wounded, Johnson managed to drive his cruiser a short distance before crashing into a nearby field — a final act of duty. In heartfelt interviews, King spoke of grief not only for Johnson’s family, but for the sister she felt she’d lost years before the tragedy. 'I already lost her a long time ago,' she told the Salt Lake Tribune. 'My heart is breaking for Derek’s family. I’m so sorry.' Derek Johnson, honored as the 2012 Community Policing Officer of the Year, was remembered in his obituary as someone whose laughter could brighten any room, who built genuine connections, and lived with purpose. He leaves behind his wife, Shante, and their 6-year-old son, Ben — whose future now carries the legacy of a man who gave everything to protect others.

Tema 6-aastane poeg Ben seisis ema Shantega koos, kinni hoides lippu, kui ametnikud kandsid Johnsoni lipuga kaetud sarnu laua ees. Kohalike inimeste suur vastuvõtt näitas suurt austust mehe vastu, kes oli tuntud oma sõbralikkuse, huumori ja pühendumise eest avaliku turvalisuse eest. 'Ta oli alates algusest halb uus', ütles King. 'Ma proovisin teda päästa. Aga ta valis teda.' Walker, kellel oli varasem rekord väikeste varguste jaoks, kuid mitte vägivaldse tegevuse jaoks, oli väidetavalt sihistanud Johnsonile pärast seda, kui politseisõidukil oli märkunud nende parkitud Volvot. Tunnetes sügavat kurbust, rääkis King mitte ainult Johnsoni perekonna jaoks, vaid ka õe jaoks, keda ta tundis juba aastaid kaotanud olevat. 'Ma kaotasin teda juba palju aega tagasi,' ütles ta Salt Lake Tribune'ile. 'Minu süda kibestub Derek'i perekonna jaoks. Ma olen väga vabandust.' Derek Johnson, kes sai aasta 2012 kõige tähtsamaks ühiskondlikuks politseiametnikuks, mälestati oma surmaga kui inimest, kelle naeratusest saatis iga ruumi valgust ja kes loobus tõelisi sidemeid. Ta elas mõtlikult ja jäi jäljele oma abikaasa Shante ja 6-aastase poja Beni jaoks — kelle tulevik kandis kõiki selle mehe väärtusi, kes andis kõik, et kaitsta teisi.

article_content: By Daily Mail Reporter. PUBLISHED: 09:52 EST, 3 April 2013. | UPDATED: 01:57 EST, 4 April 2013. Celebrity: Stoned Fox may be a poorly stuffed piece of taxidermy, but that hasn’t stopped him from achieving fame. This dazed-looking fox has amassed a huge fan base in Russia, where the oddly crafted creature became a surprise internet sensation after being spotted for sale on eBay. The animal — dubbed 'Stoned Fox' for its bewildered expression — proved so popular that its British creator, Adele Morse, brought him to St. Petersburg for locals to see in person. But not everyone in Russia approves. Local politicians in the city labeled the whimsical creature 'vile' and 'Russophobic'. A statement from the local Communist Party described Morse — the artist behind the fox — as an 'unfriendly emissary from England' and called for her exhibition to be shut down, according to the Daily Telegraph. The party accused her of 'mocking a great people and its history' after she was reportedly quoted as saying fans admired Stoned Fox because he 'looks a bit sad and drunk — and that’s how Russians feel'. Morse, based in Dalston, East London, insists she was misquoted. The Welsh artist is currently in Russia to hold seminars on Stoned Fox and the thousands of internet memes he inspired. She received countless images of the fox photoshopped into surreal scenarios — from sitting beside Barack Obama in the Oval Office to lounging on a park bench with Keanu Reeves. Morse had experimented with taxidermy after her pet red fox died of natural causes. She listed the result on eBay, describing it as: 'a young Red Fox made to look as though it is a human. I usually practice traditional taxidermy, but I decided to try something a little different. He is not perfect, but he does have a lot of character.' The listing promised the fox could sit on a cabinet, shelf, or plinth — a feature that clearly resonated with online users. A bidding war erupted after DJ Jack Hamill, known as Space Dimension Controller, shared the eBay link on Facebook, offering to perform a live set at the winner’s home if they bought it. Manchester music promoter Mike Boorman won the auction with a final bid of £330. True to his word, Hamill played a live set at Dance Tunnel in Dalston with Stoned Fox present. Shortly after the purchase, Morse began receiving messages from Russian internet users praising the fox. By the end of 2012, Russia’s Metro Newspaper declared Stoned Fox 'the winner of the internet' — a remarkable feat amid the global dominance of 'Gangnam Style'. Morse told WalesOnline: 'I asked what it was about the fox they liked, and they said he looks a bit sad and drunk — and that’s how Russians feel. His plastic eyes give him a glazed look, and they identify with it. They think it symbolizes the nation.' The fox’s posture makes it ideal for Photoshop edits — appearing alongside figures like Stalin, Churchill, and Roosevelt at Yalta, or mimicking Felix Baumgartner’s stratospheric jump. Even Marilyn Monroe’s iconic skirt-fluttering moment was recreated with Stoned Fox’s tail. Russian activist Alexei Navalny’s press secretary, Anna Veduta, wore a Stoned Fox T-shirt. The fox even appeared on a chocolate wrapper — a sweet moment in an odd cultural phenomenon.

Tähtis: Stoned Fox võib olla halvasti täidetud taksidermi, kuid see ei ole peatunud tal leidma kuulsust. See segaduses olev lind on saanud suure hulga fännidega Venemaal, kus ebapiisavalt täidetud olend sai üllatava interneti-sensatsiooniks pärast seda, kui ta avastati eBay-l müügiks. Loom, millele anti nimeks 'Stoned Fox' tema hämmingulise näo tõttu, tõi oma briti looja Adele Morse'i St. Peterburgisse, et kohalikud inimesed saaksid teda lähemalt vaadata. Kuid mitte kõik Venemaal on Stoned Foxiga nõus. Kohalikud poliitikud sellel naeruväärsel olendil kutsusid 'kõrvalekaldumiseks' ja 'vene-viisaks'. Kohaliku Kommunistliku Partei avaldus kirjeldas Morse’i — looja — kui 'sõbralikku saatjat Inglismaalt' ja nõudis tema eksponeerimise lõpetamist, nagu raporteeris Daily Telegraph. Partei süüdistas teda 'suurte rahvaste ja nende ajaloo naeruväärtusse panemises', pärast seda, kui ta oli väidetavalt öelnud, et fännid armastavad Stoned Foxi, sest 'ta näeb välja natuke kaeblikult ja jooksinult — nii tunnevad venelased'. Morse, kes elab Dalstonis, Ida-Londonis, väidab, et ta oli valesti tsiteeritud. See walesi kunstnik on hetkel Venemaal, et pidada seminarid Stoned Foxi ja teda inspireerinud tuhandete interneti-memide kohta. Ta sai suurt hulka pilte, kus loom oli fotoshopitud erinevatesse absurdsesse stseenidesse — näiteks Barack Obamaga Ovali toas või Keanu Reevesiga parkpungal. Morse oli eksperimenteerinud taksidermiaga pärast seda, kui tema kõrge punane kettas suri looduslikult. Ta lisas tulemuse eBay-le, kirjeldades seda kui: 'noor punane kettas, mis on tehtud nii, et ta näeks välja nagu inimene. Ma tavaliselt harjun traditsioonilise taksidermiaga, kuid otsustasin proovida midagi veidi teistsugust. Ta pole ideaalne, kuid tal on palju karaktri.' Auctioni kirjeldus lubas, et kettas saab istuda kabinetil, toolil, kõrvalt või plintil — omadus, mis selgelt vastas interneti kasutajatele. Hinnakõikumine algas pärast seda, kui DJ Jack Hamill, tuntud kui Space Dimension Controller, jagas eBay-i linki Facebookis, pakudes ise esitust kohalikus kodus, kui keegi võitis. Manchesteri muusika promooter Mike Boorman võitis auktsiooni lõplikul hinnal 330 nael sterlingi. Tema sõna järgi mängis Hamill elavalt Dance Tunnelis Dalstonis, kus Stoned Fox oli esindatud. Pärast ostmist alistas Morse saatesid venelaste interneti kasutajatelt, kes rõõmustasid kettast. 2012. aasta lõpus nimetas Vene Metro-uudiste ajaleht Stoned Foxi 'interneti võitjaks' — märkimisväärne saavutus samal ajal, kui 'Gangnam Style' domineeris veebi. Morse ütles WalesOnline: 'Ma küsisin, miks nad armastavad kettast, ja nad ütlesid, et ta näeb välja natuke kaeblikult ja jooksinult — nii tunnevad venelased. Tema plastikusilmad annavad talle kleepsulise vaate, ja nad identifitseerivad endaga. Nad arvavad, et ta sümboliseerib riiki.' Kettaseisu on lihtne fotoshopida — ta ilmub näiteks Staliniga, Churchilliga ja Rooseveltiga Jalta konverentsil või imiteerib Felix Baumgartneri stratosfäärse hüppamist. Isegi Marilyn Monroe ikooniline rohkuse hetk on loodud Stoned Foxi sabaga. Venemaa aktivisti Alexei Navalny pressiesindaja Anna Veduta kandsid Stoned Foxi T-pärlit. Kettas ilmus isegi šokolaadipakendil — magus hetk igasuguses kultuurilises fenomenis.

article_content: The story of how I became a national figure in the media is well known — but few understand what I actually did for the CIA. As a covert operations officer, I specialized in nuclear counter-proliferation: preventing hostile states and terrorist groups from acquiring nuclear weapons. My work involved infiltrating and disrupting procurement networks in rogue nations — a high-stakes blend of strategy, creativity, and precision. I believed it was the most vital mission of our time. I resigned from the CIA in 2006 because, after my covert identity was exposed in 2003, I could no longer carry out the clandestine work I was trained for — and loved. That exposure came as retaliation against my husband, Ambassador Joe Wilson, after he publicly challenged the Bush administration’s misuse of intelligence to justify the Iraq War. Yet I never lost my conviction that nuclear terrorism remains the most urgent threat facing humanity. Nor did I abandon my commitment to confronting it — I simply changed how I fight. Today, I’m part of Global Zero, a global coalition of political, military, religious, and civic leaders working toward the complete elimination of all nuclear weapons. The danger is real. Over the past 20 years, nuclear materials have been lost or stolen at least 25 times. Enough highly enriched uranium (HEU) exists today to build more than 100,000 bombs. Terrorists could easily smuggle a shoebox-sized amount of HEU into any major city — and with 100,000 shipping containers entering the U.S. daily, detection is nearly impossible. Black markets thrive. Pakistan’s Dr. A. Q. Khan sold nuclear blueprints and components for years — until my CIA team helped dismantle his network in 2003, catching him red-handed attempting to deliver a full nuclear weapon to Libya’s Muammar Gadhafi. But the threat isn’t just terrorism. Nine nations hold over 23,000 nuclear weapons. The U.S. and Russia alone possess 96% of them — and keep thousands on hair-trigger alert, ready to launch within minutes. Accidental or unauthorized launches remain a terrifying possibility. The only lasting solution? Global Zero: locking down all nuclear materials and eliminating all nuclear weapons. There’s momentum. President Obama and President Medvedev are finalizing the most significant arms reduction treaty in 20 years — cutting their arsenals by a third. Next week, Obama hosts a global summit in Washington to secure nuclear materials worldwide. Global Zero has already laid out a clear roadmap: Phase one calls for the U.S. and Russia to reduce their warheads to 1,000 each. Other nuclear states must freeze their arsenals. The world must unite to halt production, secure stockpiles, intercept smuggling, and eventually dismantle all weapons — followed by the first-ever multilateral nuclear disarmament talks. I’m honored to stand with Global Zero — alongside former heads of state, generals, and young activists alike. That’s why I agreed to appear in 'Countdown to Zero,' a powerful new documentary by Lawrence Bender ('An Inconvenient Truth') that premiered at Sundance in January 2010 to critical acclaim. Releasing in U.S. theaters in July 2010, it’s a chilling wake-up call about the real risks of nuclear weapons — and a rallying cry for action. If governments fail to act now, I fear we will see a nuclear detonation in our lifetimes — by a state or a terrorist group. Change won’t happen unless we demand it. Talk about it. Write to your leaders. Share this message. Visit globalzero.org and sign the declaration. The clock is ticking — but we still have time to turn the tide.
translated_content: Minu tuntuse saavutamise lugu on laialt teada, kuid vähesed teavad, mida ma tegelikult CIA jaoks teinud olen. Olin salajase operatsiooni ametnik, kes spetsialiseerus tuumavastase levimise vastu — ehk siis tagasin, et halvad inimesed ei saaks tuumapomme. Minu töö oli luua ja juhtida operatsioone, mis uurisid ja häirivad riikide ostuvõrgustikke ja varustusahelaid. See oli intensiivne, taktiline, loov ja nõudlik töö. Uskusin, et pole midagi olulisemat, mida teha peaks. Lõpetasin CIA teenistuse 2006. aastal, sest pärast seda, kui minu salajane identiteet 2003. aastal paljastati, ei suutnud ma enam teha salajast tööd, milleks ma oli hästi harjutatud ja mida ma armastasin. See paljastus oli reaktsioon oma abikaasa, suursaadiku Joe Wilsoni vastu, kes kirjutas avaliku arvamuse, milles ta süüdistas valget majja tõendite väärkasutuses, mis viis meid Iraagi sõtta. Kuid ma ei kaotanud usku, et tuumaterorism on kõige kiirem oht, millega me kohtume. Ma ei kaotanud ka oma rõõmu töötada, kuigi uues viisil, et lahendada seda ohtu. Töötan praegu selle küsimusega Global Zero liikumises, kus poliitilised, sõjalised ja usulised juhid, ekspertid ja aktivistid püüavad kõigi tuumapommide maailmas kaotamist. Teame, et terroriorganisatsioonid on proovinud osta, ehitada või varastada pommide. Viimasel kahel aastakümnel on tuumapommide materjale kaotatud või varastatud vähemalt 25 korda. Maailmas on täna piisavalt kõrge rikastatud uraaniga, et ehitada üle 100 000 pommi. Terroristid, kes otsivad kõrge rikastatud uraanide ostmiseks või varastamiseks, võivad vaadata umbes 40 riiki, kus on tuumamaterjale. Ja siis on veel olemas eraldiseisvad isikud, kes juhivad musti turbe, müües tuumamaterjale ja tehnilisi lahendusi. Pakistani dr. A. Q. Khan teeb seda aastaid enne, kui mu CIA grupp peatas teda detsembris 2003, kui kinnistasime, et ta müüb täieliku tuumapommi Libüa režiimile Moammar Gadhafile. Kui terroristidel õnnestub saada piisavalt kõrge rikastatud uraanide, võivad nad seda viia sihtmärgi linna, ehitada pommi ja lülitada sisse. Sada naela kõrge rikastatud uraanide mahub kujundusse, ja 100 000 konteinerit tuleb Ameerika Ühendriikidesse iga päev. Tuumaohu ei piirata ainult terrorismiga. On ka ohtud levimise ja juhusliku või lubamata tuumalaua käivitamise kohta. Täna on üheksal riigil rohkem kui 23 000 tuumapommi ja Ameerika Ühendriigid ja Venemaa säilitavad ikka tuhandeid tuumapomme kõrge ohu all, valmis käivitada mõne minutiga. Ainoaks viisiks, et kõrvaldada tuumapommide kasutamise oht riikide konfliktides, juhuslikult või terroristide poolt, on kõik tuumamaterjalid kinni hoida ja kõik tuumapommid kõigis riikides kõrvaldada: globaalne null. Täna on meil reaalselt võimalus määrata kursi globaalsete nullide poole. Ameerika Ühendriikide president Obama ja Venemaa president Dmitry Medvedev, kelle riikidel on 22 000 tuumapommi või 96 protsenti maailma varudest, allkirjastavad lepingu, mis vähendab nende strateegilisi tuumavarusid kolmandiku võrra igaühele. See on kõige olulisem relvade vähendamise leping kaheteistkümne aasta jooksul ja oluline esimene samm. Järgmisel nädalal korraldab Obama 48 riigi juhtide summiteenistuse Washingtonis, et käsitleda globaalset tuumaohtu ja alustada programme kõigi tuumamaterjalide maailmas kinni hoidmiseks. Kui Ameerika Ühendriigid ja Venemaa juhivad, võib 2010. aasta märkida tuumapommide lõpu algust. Kuid globaalse nulli saavutamine võtab aastaid, reaalsed planeeringud ja suuremat poliitilist tahtmist. Veebruaris kohtusid Global Zero liikumise juhid Pariisis ja esitasid samm-sammulise plaani kõigi jäänud tuumapommide kõrvaldamiseks. Plaan, mille toetasid sadadad endised riigipead, välisministrid, riigikaitse nõunikud ja sõjaväelised juhid, nõuab esimeses faasis, et Ameerika Ühendriigid ja Venemaa vähendaksid oma varusid 1000 sõjalise relva koguseni. Kõik teised riigid, millel on tuumarelvi, peavad oma varusid fikseerima, ja rahvusvaheline ühiskond peab korraldama täieliku globaalse pingutuse, et takistada tuumarelvade edasist levimist ja kinni hoida kõiki tuumamaterjale. Tuumapommide materjalide kinnihoidmine hõlmab turvaliste hoidlaite ehitamist, kõigi varude registreerimist, materjalide transpordi kaitset (transpordiks on kõige tundlikum terrori- ja varastamisoht), eksportide reguleerimist, varastamistoimingute peatamist, uute pommimaterjalide tootmise lõpetamist ja lõpuks olemasolevate varude kõrvaldamist. Need sammud järgnevad ajalooliselt esimesele multinaatsionaalsele läbirääkimistele kõigi tuumarelvade riikide vahel. Olen rõõmus, et töötan Global Zero liikumisega ja tema maailma juhtide ja rahvaste organisatorite, presidendite ja ülikooliõpilaste kõrval. Ma soovin teha kõike, mida saan, et tõsta avalikku ja poliitilist toetust tuumarelvade kõrvaldamiseks. Ja see on põhjus, miks ma ütlesin jah, kui Lawrence Bender, produtsent filmidele 'An Inconvenient Truth', 'Good Will Hunting' ja 'Inglorious Basterds', palus mulle olla erilises ja kõvasti kõlab dokumentaalfilmis 'Countdown to Zero', mis esietendus jaanuaris Sundancel ja mille esietendus oli kriitiliselt auhindatud ning mis avaldatakse Ameerika Ühendriikide kinodes juulis. See film on imeline äratustund, mis teatab kodanikele ja meie poliitilistele juhtidele tuumarelvade ohtudest, sealhulgas levimisest, tuumaterorismist ja juhuslikust tuumalaua käivitamisest. See ehitab teadlikkust ja toetust Global Zero liikumisele tuumarelvade kõrvaldamiseks. Minu kogemuste põhjal ma usun, et kui valitsused ei toimi nüüd, et alustada kõigi jäänud tuumapommide kõrvaldamist, näeme me elu jooksul pommide kasutamist riigi või terroristi poolt. Et saavutada valitsuste tegutsemist, peab igaüks osalema, oma häälet kuuldama, viima selle küsimuse poliitilise agendani, igasse kodu ja igale blogile ja ajalehele. On veel aega muuta suunda ja määrata kursi globaalsete nullide poole, kuid kell käib. Lisateabe saamiseks ja osalemiseks kasvava liikumise juures minege globalzero.org ja allkirjastage deklaratsioon. Selle kommentaari avaldatud arvamused on ainult Valerie Plame Wilsoni omad.
